https://www.inquirer.net/496354/comelec-.body: Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said the certification is free regardless of the number of copies requested or whether it is obtained from the commission’s main office or any of its field offices. “Comelec gives all voter certifications for free in the whole Philippines, whether it is here in the main office or in the field, there is no fee,” Garcia said. However, Garcia said the commission’s verification found that the post came from a fake account. “We verified, we counter-checked; it turns out that it is a fake account. So there are people like that,” he said. https://www.inquirer.net/496354/comelec-.body_zh: 国家选举委员会主席George Erwin Garcia表示，无论申请多少份选民证明，也无论从委员会总部还是任何地方办公室领取，证明均免费。Garcia说：“国家选举委员会在整个菲律宾免费提供所有选民证明，无论是在总部还是地方办公室领取，都不收费。”他提到苏丹库达拉特省流传的一些报告，称申请人每份选民证明需支付P20。不过，Garcia表示，委员会核查后发现，相关帖子来自虚假账号。他说：“我们进行了核查和交叉验证，结果证明它是一个虚假账号。因此，确实存在这样的人。”阅读：选民登记计划拟扩大至更多市镇。另外，国家选举委员会第 XII 区办公室也回应了一则社交媒体帖子，称一名选民在北哥打巴托Matalam的国家选举委员会办公室领取证明时被收取P20。该区域办公室在社交媒体发布声明，强调选民证明免费，并警告不得擅自收费。声明称：“我们强调，根据现行国家选举委员会规定，签发选民证明完全免费。我们绝不容忍任何未经授权的费用收取。”阅读：国家选举委员会将于11月10日至7月30日为2028年选举开放选民登记。该区域办公室表示，已启动调查并正联系该社交媒体账号的所有者，以获取她对事件的陈述及任何现有证据。该办公室还否认曾将投诉人称为‘reklamador’的说法。声明称：“特此说明，我们的办公室没有进行过此类沟通，我们也未说过任何此类言论。”该区域办公室表示，正严肃对待此事，并继续致力于在服务中维护问责、专业和诚信。您的订阅未能保存，请重试。您的订阅已成功。办公室说：“公众有权获得诚实、公平和免费的选举服务。”/jpv

https://www.inquirer.net/496318/comelec-.body: According to data provided by Comelec Chairperson George Erwin Garcia to reporters on Thursday, the poll body processed 107,346 voter registrations. Comelec reopened registration on November 10, and the drive will run until July 30, 2027. The Comelec also noted that female voter registrants (58,762) outnumbered male registrants (49,076). READ: Comelec surprised by ‘overwhelming’ turnout as voter registration opens Meanwhile, Calabarzon (Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal, and Quezon) logged the highest number of applications, with 26,934, followed by the National Capital Region with 20,151 and Central Luzon with 11,662. The poll body earlier said it was optimistic that it would exceed its target of registering three million additional voters for the much-anticipated 2028 elections. It also noted long queues at registration sites across the country when it resumed the drive. Many of those who lined up on the first day of the resumed voter registration were young Filipinos. Garcia earlier said that seeing the youth register to vote was a “good indication.” Interested voter registrants can submit their applications through the local offices of their respective election officers, satellite or mall registration sites, and the Register Anywhere Program. READ: Registering to vote in 2028? Here’s what you need to know Aside from first-time registration, the poll body said it can also accommodate requests for transfer and reactivation of registration, as well as modifications to details in existing records. To register as a voter, an individual must be at least 18 years old on or before election day on May 8, 2028. They must also have resided in the Philippines for at least one year and in the place where they intend to vote for at least six months immediately preceding the elections. https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.body: LONDON — Kemi Badenoch called Donald Trump’s trilateral meeting in Shenzhen “disturbing” — as she placed significant distance between the U.K.’s opposition Conservatives and the U.S president. “It’s basically an administration on its way out — we should be looking to the future,” the Tory leader told the BBC Thursday morning when pressed on Trump’s White House. The U.S. president is holding three-way talks with his “ friend ” Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese premier Xi Jinping. Trump has defended his decision to engage directly with two leaders whose countries are often at odds with Washington, saying he has “a special responsibility to maintain open, respectful and productive dialogue on issues impacting not just our people, but the entire planet.” “Disturbing is how I would describe it,” Badenoch told the Today program when pressed on the summit. “There are three world leaders who look like they’re trying to carve up the world between them.” She argued that the three leaders are trying to forge a tripolar world where the Chinese president commands Asia, the American the western hemisphere, and the Russian gets Europe. “That is very concerning, especially seeing Donald Trump call president Putin his friend. Russia is not America’s friend,” Badenoch added. It’s another notable break by a British right-wing leader with the U.S. commander-in-chief. Badenoch praised Trump after his return the White House, and even looked enviously at initiatives like DOGE and ICE . But like Nigel Farage , the leader of her right-wing rivals in the Reform UK party, Badenoch has been distancing the Conservatives from Trump as the effects of his foreign policy become apparent in the U.K. Her latest comments come after Trump’s Republicans took a major hit in the U.S. mid-terms. Badenoch called for Britain to strengthen partnerships “with all our allies,” including in the U.S., Canada and Europe — a clear tilt beyond Trump
https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.title_zh: 英国保守党党首巴德诺克批评特朗普、普京和习近平的三边互动“令人不安”
https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.body_zh: 伦敦——凯米·巴德诺奇称唐纳德·特朗普在深圳举行的三方会议“令人不安”，并明确划清了英国反对党保守党与美国总统之间的距离。周四上午，BBC记者追问特朗普入主白宫一事时，这位保守党领袖表示：“这基本上是一个即将届满的政府——我们应当着眼未来。”美国总统正与其“朋友”俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国总理习近平举行三方会谈。特朗普为直接与这两位领导人接触辩护说，他们所在的国家经常与华盛顿存在分歧，但他“肩负着特别责任，应就不仅影响本国人民、而且影响整个地球的问题维持开放、尊重且富有成效的对话”。巴德诺奇在《今日》节目中被追问此次峰会时表示：“我会把它形容为令人不安。这三位世界领导人看起来像是企图在彼此之间瓜分世界。”她认为，这三位领导人正试图塑造一个三极世界：中国总统掌控亚洲，美国总统掌控西半球，俄罗斯则获得欧洲。巴德诺奇补充道：“这非常令人担忧，尤其是看到唐纳德·特朗普称普京总统为朋友。俄罗斯不是美国的朋友。”这是又一位英国右翼领袖与美国最高统帅公开拉开距离。特朗普重返白宫后，巴德诺奇曾对他表示赞赏，甚至对DOGE和ICE等举措心生羡慕。然而，与英国改革党leader奈杰尔·法拉奇一样，随着特朗普外交政策的影响在英国日益显现，巴德诺奇一直在推动保守党与特朗普保持距离。巴德诺奇最新表态之际，特朗普所属的共和党刚刚在美国中期选举中遭遇重大挫败。巴德诺奇呼吁英国加强“与所有盟友”的伙伴关系，包括美国、加拿大和欧洲——这清楚表明其立场已超越特朗普……

https://leadership.ng/stop-creating-enem.body: The governor gave the warning on Wednesday in Keffi while inaugurating the campaign council of the APC senatorial candidate for Nasarawa West, Dr. Faisal Shuaib. “Most times, we create enemies as a result of rumours and suspicions. Sometimes, even when I hear something, I don’t act until I establish the truth. That is how we can move on,” Sule said. He told party leaders, stakeholders and campaign officials at the event that unity was no longer a slogan but a condition for survival ahead of the 2027 general elections. According to him, the APC in Nasarawa West cannot afford to go into the election divided, with supporters working at cross-purposes and camps tearing each other down. He urged the newly inaugurated council to work for all APC candidates, and not to concentrate its energy on individual ambitions. “Elections are won and lost at the polling units and at the wards. So, when you are empowering people at the ward level, you are empowering the right people,” he said. Sule commended Dr. Shuaib for providing financial and logistical support to the campaign council, noting that strengthening party structures at ward and polling unit levels was the surest path to victory. In his remarks, Dr. Shuaib said his campaign would pursue a collective APC victory, from the presidential election to the State House of Assembly. “APC Sak means we deliver our presidential candidate, Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu; Senator Ahmed Aliyu Wadada as the next governor of Nasarawa State; and win the Senate, House of Representatives and State House of Assembly seats,” he said. To back his pledge, Shuaib announced N81.65 million in financial support for grassroots mobilisation, 15 operational vehicles for local government coordinators and 124 motorcycles for ward coordinators and other stakeholders across the five local government areas. He described the resources as tools for work, not gifts for loyalty. “These are not gifts; they are tools. We have given you the tools, now give us the results,” he said. Dr. Shuaib said his proposed representation would be guided by the DFS CARES agenda, focusing on community development, agriculture, poverty alleviation, education, healthcare, women and youth empowerment, skills development and security. Former Governor and former APC National Chairman, Senator Abdullahi Adamu, also called for fairness, justice and sustained party unity, urging stakeholders to support all APC candidates and avoid abandoning anyone in the political process. The APC State Chairman, Dr. Aliyu Bello, urged party members to remain loyal and shun anti-party activities, while calling on women to take their rightful place in the party’s activities. https://leadership.ng/stop-creating-enem.body_zh: 州长于周三在凯菲发出警告，当时他正在为尼日利亚进步大会党在纳萨拉瓦西部选区的参议员候选人费萨尔·舒艾卜博士的竞选委员会揭幕。苏莱说：“很多时候，我们会因为谣言和猜疑而树敌。有时，即使听到一些消息，我也要先查明真相才会采取行动。我们只有这样才能继续前进。”他还在活动现场对党内领导人、利益相关者和竞选官员表示，在2027年大选前，团结已不再只是一句口号，而是生存的条件。据他说，尼日利亚进步大会党在纳萨拉瓦西部不能带着分裂进入选举，不能让支持者各行其是，更不能让不同阵营相互拆台。他敦促新揭幕的委员会为尼日利亚进步大会党所有候选人开展工作，不要把精力集中在个人野心上。他说：“选举的成败是在各投票站和选区决定的。因此，当你赋予选区民众权力时，你就是在赋予正确的人权力。”苏莱赞扬舒艾卜博士向竞选委员会提供财政和后勤支持，并指出，加强党在选区和投票站层面的组织，是取胜最可靠的途径。舒艾卜博士在讲话中表示，他的竞选将争取尼日利亚进步大会党集体获胜，从总统选举一直延伸到州议会选举。他说：“尼日利亚进步大会党获胜意味着我们要确保总统候选人阿西瓦朱·博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布当选；让艾哈迈德·阿利尤·瓦达达参议员成为纳萨拉瓦州下一任州长；并赢得参议院、众议院和州议会的席位。”为支持这一承诺，舒艾卜宣布提供8165万奈拉，用于基层动员；向地方政府协调人员提供15辆 operational 车辆；并向五个地方行政区的选区协调人员及其他利益相关者提供124辆摩托车。他称，这些资源是工作工具，而不是换取忠诚的礼物。他说：“这些不是礼物，而是工具。我们已经给了你们工具，现在请交出成果。”舒艾卜博士表示，他所提议的代表工作将以DFS CARES议程为指导，重点关注社区发展、农业、扶贫、教育、医疗保健、妇女和青年赋能、技能发展以及安全。前州长、前尼日利亚进步大会党全国主席阿卜杜拉希·阿达穆参议员也呼吁公平、正义和持续保持党内团结，敦促利益相关者支持尼日利亚进步大会党所有候选人，避免在政治进程中抛弃任何人。尼日利亚进步大会党州主席阿利尤·贝洛博士敦促党内成员保持忠诚，远离反党活动，同时呼吁妇女在党内活动中发挥其应有作用。我们掌握独家优势。获取直接发送到您手机的实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，在WhatsApp上获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Korean brands eye China comeback, but face tougher local rivals
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: China's K-culture ban ease offers new opportunities but competition looms Korean entertainment and consumer brands are poised to gain greater access to China under a new trade agreement, but they face tougher local competition than when Beijing first restricted Korean cultural exports nearly a decade ago, market watchers said Thursday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 中国放宽K文化禁令带来新机遇，但韩国娱乐和消费品牌面临竞争。根据市场观察人士周四的说法，在一项新贸易协议下，韩国娱乐和消费品牌将能更广泛地进入中国市场，但它们将面临比北京近十年前首次限制韩国文化出口时更激烈的本地竞争。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: China's K-culture ban ease offers new opportunities but competition looms Korean entertainment and consumer brands are poised to gain greater access to China under a new trade agreement, but they face tougher local competition than when Beijing first restricted Korean cultural exports nearly a decade ago, market watchers said Thursday. Seoul and Beijing agreed Wednesday to expand their free trade agreement to cover services and investment after more than eight years of talks. The deal could boost bilateral services trade, which has long lagged behind merchandise trade. The entertainment industry stands to be among the biggest beneficiaries. China was the world's second-largest content market in 2024 and was growing faster than the U.S. market, according to the Korea Creative Content Agency. With K-pop enjoying a far stronger global following than before the restrictions, easing barriers could bring more live concerts to China, expand Korean music's presence on Chinese streaming platforms and open doors for Korean game developers. The potential reopening follows years of strained economic ties between the two neighbors. Korean companies invested heavily in China after the latter joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, helping transform the country into a manufacturing powerhouse while boosting productivity at home. Relations soured after Seoul deployed the U.S. Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) missile system in 2017, prompting Beijing to impose unofficial restrictions on Korean popular culture, known as the Korean wave. "Korean content has faced significant restrictions in China," said Troy Stangarone, a non-resident fellow at the Carnegie Mellon Institute for Strategy and Technology. "But issues with piracy and local reproductions of Korean content demonstrate that there is still strong demand." Yet Korean companies face a markedly different Chinese market from the one they left behind. Chinese dramas are gaining audiences on global streaming platforms such as Netflix, while domestic game developers have strengthened their capabilities and found success overseas. "Beijing has consistently denied the existence of any formal restrictions on Korean cultural content. The mere fact that regulatory easing has been explicitly written into the agreement carries considerable significance," said Lee Ki-hoon, an analyst at Hana Securities. "The eased restrictions, however, largely target sectors where Chinese firms can already compete." Korean cosmetics brands face a similar challenge as they seek to capitalize on improved ties with China, one of K-beauty's earliest overseas markets. Domestic beauty brands, collectively known as C-beauty, have gained ground as Chinese consumers increasingly favor local products. They accounted for 55.7 percent of the market in 2024, according to the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency. "Chinese beauty brands may arguably already exceed K-beauty in absolute value and consumer reach," Chloe Zhu, a consultant at Euromonitor International, earlier told The Korea Times . "The scale of local demand provides a structural advantage that few other markets can match." Closer ties could also bring more Chinese tourists to Korea, offering a boost to sluggish domestic demand. Seoul had already eased visa requirements for group and independent travelers ahead of the agreement. Still, more arrivals may do little to lift sales at duty-free operators, which have long relied heavily on Chinese visitors . Foreign tourists increasingly favor lower-priced products at retailers such as Daiso and Olive Young over luxury goods sold at duty-free stores, according to industry officials. "Korean companies will need to develop products and tailored services that reflect evolving Chinese consumer preferences since the restrictions took effect," said Park So-young, a senior researcher at Korea International Trade Association. The opening, however, cuts both ways, potentially giving Chinese companies a stronger foothold in Korea's domestic market. Chinese e-commerce platforms, including AliExpress and Temu, are set to gain greater access to Korea's services market, with provisions allowing them to establish local subsidiaries and logistics centers. Payment services such as Alipay and travel platforms including Trip.com could also face fewer barriers. Skepticism also remains over whether China will follow through on easing restrictions, with Korean businesses wary after their experience with the THAAD dispute. "Korean consumers, they will make up their own minds as to what mainland Chinese content and products they want to buy and enjoy," said Sean King, senior vice president at Park Strategies. "Korean providers should beware ... that Beijing may well let in Korean content and products today – but just as soon block it again tomorrow."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩国品牌寻求重返中国市场，但面临实力更强的本土竞争对手
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 中国放宽K文化限制带来新机遇，但竞争压力显现。市场观察人士周四表示，根据一项新贸易协定，韩国娱乐和消费品牌即将获得更大的中国市场准入，但它们将面对比北京近十年前首次限制韩国文化出口时更严酷的本地竞争。首尔和北京周三同意扩大自由贸易协定，将服务和投资纳入其中，相关谈判已持续八年多。该协议有望促进双边服务贸易，而服务贸易长期以来一直落后于货物贸易。娱乐业可能成为最大的受益者之一。据韩国创意内容局称，2024年中国是全球第二大内容市场，增速也快于美国市场。随着K-pop在全球的人气远强于限制措施出台前，放宽壁垒可能让更多韩国演唱会走进中国，扩大韩国音乐在中国流媒体平台上的影响力，也为韩国游戏开发商打开机会。潜在的重启紧随两国多年紧张的经济关系而来。2001年中国加入世界贸易组织后，韩国企业在中国大举投资，帮助中国把自身打造为制造业 powerhouse，同时提升了韩国国内的生产率。2017年，首尔部署美国“终端高空区域防御”（THAAD）导弹系统，双边关系随之恶化，北京对韩国流行文化实施了非正式限制，也就是所谓的韩国文化waves。卡内基梅隆国际战略与技术研究所非驻所研究员Troy Stangarone表示：“韩国内容在中国一直受到重大限制。”“但盗版和韩国内容本地复制问题表明，需求依然强劲。”然而，韩国企业面对的中国市场与它们当年离开时已大不相同。中国电视剧正在Netflix等全球流媒体平台上吸引观众，本土游戏开发商则增强了自身能力，并在海外取得成功。Hana Securities分析师Lee Ki-hoon表示：“北京一直否认存在任何针对韩国文化内容的正式限制。仅仅将监管放宽明确写入协议这一点，就具有相当重要的意义。”“不过，放宽的限制主要针对中国企业已经能够参与竞争的行业。”韩国化妆品品牌也面临类似挑战，它们希望利用与中国关系改善带来的机遇，而中国是K-beauty最早开拓的海外市场之一。统称为C-beauty的中国本土美妆品牌正在扩大市场份额，因为中国消费者越来越偏爱本土产品。据韩国贸易投资促进局称，2024年本土美妆品牌占市场份额的55.7%。Euromonitor International顾问Chloe Zhu早些时候告诉《韩国时报》称：“可以说，无论从绝对价值还是消费者覆盖面来看，中国美妆品牌或许已经超过K-beauty。”“本地需求的规模提供了一种结构性的优势，几乎没有其他市场能够匹敌。”关系改善还可能吸引更多中国游客赴韩，为低迷的国内需求注入动力。在协议达成前，首尔已经放宽了团体游客和散客的签证要求。不过，更多游客到访或许仍难以提振免税运营商的销售，因为这些运营商长期高度依赖中国游客。据行业官员表示，外国游客越来越青睐Daiso和Olive Young等零售商销售的价格较低的商品，而不是免税店出售的奢侈品。韩国国际贸易协会高级研究员Park So-young表示：“自限制措施生效以来，韩国消费者的偏好一直在变化，韩国企业需要开发反映这种变化的产品并提供定制服务。”然而，这项开放也会产生双向影响，可能让中国企业在韩国本土市场获得更稳固的立足点。包括AliExpress和Temu在内的中国电商平台将更容易进入韩国服务市场，协议条款允许它们设立本地子公司和物流中心。Alipay等支付服务以及Trip.com等旅游平台也可能面临更少的障碍。对于中国是否会切实履行放宽限制的承诺，人们仍持怀疑态度；THAAD争端之后，韩国商界一直心有余悸。Park Strategies高级副总裁Sean King表示：“韩国消费者会自行决定想要购买和欣赏哪些中国大陆的内容与产品。”“韩国供应商应当保持警惕……北京今天或许会允许韩国内容和产品进入，但明天同样可能再次将其阻挡在外。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title: Upgraded FTA expected to boost Korea-China tourism ties, experts say
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary: The newly agreed expansion of the Korea-China free trade agreement is expected to give a significant boost to Korea's travel industry by opening direct sales channels in China and encouraging broader bilateral tourism exchanges, industry experts said Thursday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 行业专家周四表示，新近达成的韩中自由贸易协定扩大版预计将显著提振韩国旅游业，为其在中国开辟直销渠道，并促进两国旅游交流进一步扩大。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: The newly agreed expansion of the Korea-China free trade agreement is expected to give a significant boost to Korea's travel industry by opening direct sales channels in China and encouraging broader bilateral tourism exchanges, industry experts said Thursday. While major Korean package tour operators may not immediately jump into competing directly with Chinese travel agencies, the deal will help add more flights between the two countries and boost both inbound and outbound travel demand, they added. On Wednesday, Korea and China reached a substantial conclusion in their follow-up free trade agreement negotiations on services and investment during a bilateral summit held on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said. Under the upgraded pact, Korean travel agencies established in 23 designated regions across China will be permitted to directly recruit Chinese group tourists and sell overseas tour packages to both Chinese citizens and foreign residents. The designated areas cover 11 pilot zones, including Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing and Hainan, along with 12 pilot free trade zones in provinces such as Guangdong, Henan, Hubei and Sichuan. According to the Korea Association of Travel Agents (KATA), the 11 pilot zones alone had a combined resident population of 188.82 million as of the end of 2025. Industry groups welcomed the breakthrough as a long-awaited opportunity to expand their footprint. "This will serve as a historic milestone that expands entry into the Chinese market, a long-cherished wish of our travel industry, and elevates bilateral tourism exchanges to the next level," KATA Chairman Lee Jin-seok said. Major domestic package tour agencies, which mainly focus on outbound travel for Koreans, see the agreement as a broader catalyst for market recovery, rather than an immediate entry into China's local inbound sector. "Since major domestic package travel agencies barely operate inbound businesses, there may be no immediate direct impact from running local operations in China, especially given the risks of competing against established local players," an official from Yellow Balloon, a travel agency in Seoul, said. "However, we are focusing on the broader trend of improving bilateral relations and more active exchanges," the official added. The government expects the deal to help Korean agencies earn new revenue by offering tours themed around K-pop, Korean skin care and food, as well as regional travel programs across Korea. Agencies will also have room to expand their business scope by linking Korean itineraries with third-country destinations such as Japan and Southeast Asia. The opening comes as Chinese visitors to Korea continue to rebound. According to the Korea Tourism Data Lab, 5.47 million Chinese tourists visited Korea from January through September this year, up 29.2 percent from the same period a year earlier. That nine-month figure nearly matches last year's full-year total of 5.48 million. Chinese travelers made up 32 percent of all foreign visitors during the first nine months of this year, continuing a steady rise from 29.7 percent in 2024 and 30.1 percent in 2025. They also tend to spend more than other tourists, averaging $1,504 per person last year, which was 13 percent higher than the overall foreign visitor average
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 专家称，升级后的自由贸易协定有望加强韩中旅游关系
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 行业专家周四表示 newly agreed expansion，中韩自由贸易协定扩容预计将通过在中国开辟直销渠道并推动更广泛的双边旅游交流，显著提振韩国旅游业。虽然韩国大型包价旅行社可能不会立即直接与中国旅行社展开竞争，但该协议将有助于增加两国之间的航班，并提振入境和出境旅游需求。韩国贸易工业和资源部表示，周三，韩国和中国在深圳市举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间举行的双边峰会上，就服务和投资后续自由贸易协定谈判达成了实质性结论。根据升级后的协定，在中国23个指定地区设立的韩国旅行社将获准直接招募中国团体游客，并向中国公民和外国居民销售海外旅游包价产品。指定区域包括北京、上海、重庆和海南等11个试点地区，以及广东、河南、湖北和四川等省的12个试点自由贸易区。据韩国旅行社协会（KATA）称，截至2025年底，仅这11个试点地区合计常住人口就达1.8882亿。行业团体对这一突破表示欢迎，认为这是扩大业务布局的长期期待的机会。KATA主席李进锡说：“这将成为拓展中国市场准入的历史性里程碑，实现韩国旅游业长久以来的愿望，并将双边旅游交流提升到新的水平。”韩国国内主要包价旅行社目前主要专注于韩国居民出境游，它们将这项协议视为更广泛的市场复苏催化剂，而不是立即进入中国本地入境游市场。首尔一家名为Yellow Balloon的旅行社官员说：“由于韩国国内大型包价旅行社几乎不经营入境游业务，在中国开展本地业务短期内可能不会产生直接影响，尤其是在需要与成熟的本地企业竞争的情况下。”该官员补充说：“不过，我们正在关注双边关系改善和交流更加活跃这一更广泛的趋势。”韩国政府预计，该协议将帮助韩国旅行社通过推出以K-pop、韩国护肤和美食为主题的旅游产品，以及覆盖韩国各地的区域旅游项目来创造新的收入。旅行社还可以把韩国行程与日本和东南亚等第三国目的地相连接，从而扩大业务范围。与此同时，中国游客赴韩人数持续回升。据韩国旅游数据实验室称，今年1月至9月，共有547万名中国游客访韩，同比增长29.2%。这一九个月的数据已接近去年全年548万人次的总量。今年前九个月，中国游客占所有外国游客的32%，这一占比继续稳步上升，2024年和2025年分别为29.7%和30.1%。中国游客的消费水平通常也高于其他游客，去年人均消费为1,504美元，比外国游客总体平均水平高出13%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title: Expanding Korea-China cultural exchanges
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: Beijing should honor deal on Korean films and games A day ahead of the historic trilateral meeting between China, the U.S. and Russia, President Lee Jae Myung lifted a hurdle for Korean cultural content in a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, Wednesday. A decade into an unofficial ban China has not formally acknowledged, the two leaders' agreement is expected to clear a path for Korean cultural products.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 北京应履行有关韩国电影和游戏的协议在中国、美国和俄罗斯历史性三方会谈前一天，韩国总统李在明于星期三在深圳会见中国国家主席习近平时，为韩国文化内容扫清了一处障碍。中国已实施十年的非正式禁令从未得到正式承认，但预计两位领导人达成的协议将为韩国文化产品开辟道路。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Beijing should honor deal on Korean films and games A day ahead of the historic trilateral meeting between China, the U.S. and Russia, President Lee Jae Myung lifted a hurdle for Korean cultural content in a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, Wednesday. A decade into an unofficial ban China has not formally acknowledged, the two leaders' agreement is expected to clear a path for Korean cultural products. Lee and Xi met for 34 minutes on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, follow-up second-phase free trade negotiations on services and investment that began in 2018. The agreement includes Beijing granting Seoul the most-favored nation status for its movies and games, allowing Korean travel agencies to advance into China's 23 regions and Korean companies to independently operate their brand shops in China as well. China also agreed to apply nondiscrimination principles to the review of online games, films and other content, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The agreement is fueling anticipation that more Korean content will freely access the Chinese market, including K-pop, which has largely been excluded since China protested Korea's decision to deploy a U.S. Terminal High Altitude Area Defense anti-missile defense system in 2016. Since then, Korean content faced an unofficial barrier, including the cancellation of scheduled K-pop performances. In order not to spoil the anticipation, specific tasks remain ahead, and they should be aligned with the spirit expressed by Lee and Xi during their meeting in Shenzhen. Many issues are intertwined between the two nations, both direct and pivotal for the affairs on the Korean Peninsula. But the exchange of popular content, by nature, can enable fluid cultural and commercial exchanges. There is more room for Korean services exports to China to grow. According to 2024 trade figures, trade in goods with China stood at 20.7 percent of Korea's total goods trade, while services trade accounted for 12.4 percent. The Korean trade ministry estimated that the bilateral trade between the two nations in services and investment is currently around $38.3 billion. Lee pointed out that Chinese travelers to Korea are expected to reach 10 million this year for the first time since 2019. Until Korea and China cement the trade agreement, the expectation for that figure invariably will be upward. On Thursday, the stock prices for Korea's top entertainment agencies, including HYBE, SM Entertainment and JYP Entertainment, rose for the second day. The optimism however is juxtaposed with a realistic outlook that the trade agreement does not mention large-scale K-pop performances in China. Various Korean experts have said that whether those performances will be allowed may well be the litmus test of further cultural exchanges. As is the case, the Korean government must continue to discuss, persuade and negotiate with China to enable such exchanges. Beijing should also play a part by formalizing and implementing the agreement and ensuring that the exchanges are carried out on the regional level as well. As international relations cannot eschew reciprocity, Seoul should prepare for possible demands from Beijing. The Chinese president also expressed the need for the two nations to "foster a cooperative ecosystem for emerging technology industries such as artificial intelligence." Korea, which upholds an alliance as well as a trade partnership with the U.S., should manage potentially differing interests through robust dialogue and communications with its invaluable partner nations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh:
北京应履行有关韩国电影和游戏的协议

在中国、美国和俄罗斯举行历史性三方会议前一天，韩国总统李在明周三在深圳与中国国家主席习近平会晤时，为韩国文化内容扫清了一个障碍。中国对相关禁令实施已有10年，且从未正式承认该禁令；预计两位领导人达成的协议将为韩国文化产品开辟道路。

李在明和习近平在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）经济领导人会议期间举行会谈，双方会谈了34分钟。此次会议还涉及自2018年开始的第二阶段服务贸易和投资自由化谈判后续事宜。

根据协议，北京将给予韩国电影和游戏最惠国待遇，允许韩国旅行社进入中国23个地区，也允许韩国企业在中国独立经营其品牌商店。

据韩国产业通商资源部称，中国还同意在审查网络游戏、电影和其他内容时适用非歧视原则。

这项协议激发了人们的期待，即更多韩国内容将自由进入中国市场，其中包括韩国流行音乐。自中国抗议韩国决定部署美国“终端高空区域防御”反导系统以来，韩国流行音乐基本被排除在中国市场之外。此后，韩国内容一直面临非官方障碍，韩国流行音乐原定演出也不断取消。

为了不辜负这份期待，仍有具体任务需要完成，而这些任务应当与李在明和习近平在深圳会晤时表达的精神保持一致。

两国之间许多问题相互交织，既直接影响朝鲜半岛事务，也对半岛事务至关重要。然而，流行文化内容的交流从本质上能够促进文化和商业交流的畅通。韩国对华服务出口还有更大增长空间。

根据2024年的贸易数据，韩国与中国的货物贸易占韩国货物贸易总额的20.7%，服务贸易占比为12.4%。韩国贸易部估计，目前两国服务贸易和投资双边总额约为383亿美元。

李在明指出，预计今年到访韩国的中国游客将首次达到1000万人次，这是自2019年以来的首次。在韩国和中国巩固贸易协议之前，这一数字预计无论如何都会继续上升。

周四，韩国主要娱乐企业的股价连续第二天上涨，其中包括HYBE、SM娱乐和JYP娱乐。不过，这种乐观情绪也伴随着现实预期，即贸易协议并未提及在中国举办大规模韩国流行音乐演出。

多位韩国专家表示，这些演出能否获准举行，很可能将成为进一步开展文化交流的试金石。

事实上，韩国政府必须继续与中国讨论、劝说并展开谈判，以促成此类交流。北京也应发挥作用，正式确定并落实协议，同时确保这些交流也能在地区层面得到开展。

由于国际关系无法回避互惠原则，首尔应做好应对北京可能提出要求的准备。

中国国家主席还表示，两国需要“为人工智能等新兴技术产业培育合作生态系统”。

韩国与美国既结有同盟关系，也建立了贸易伙伴关系，应通过与这些宝贵伙伴国家开展扎实对话和沟通，管理好可能各不相同的利益。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Army academy will be relocated to the central Chungcheong region, while the Navy and Air Force academies will be kept in place, the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the government said Wednesday, revising an earlier plan to merge them into a unified military college. To do so, the Korea Military Academy — the Army college — will move out of Seoul and be relocated to a site in the central-western region of Chungcheong.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 执政的朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）和政府周三表示，陆军士官学校将迁至忠清中部地区，海军和空军士官学校则维持原址不变，并修订了此前将三校合并为统一军事学院的计划。为此，陆军士官学校韩国陆军士官学校将迁出首尔，迁至忠清中部西部地区的校址。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Army academy will be relocated to the central Chungcheong region, while the Navy and Air Force academies will be kept in place, the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the government said Wednesday, revising an earlier plan to merge them into a unified military college. The revised plan retains the initial proposal to establish a joint academy at the Jaundae military complex in the central city of Daejeon, about 140 kilometers south of Seoul, but each armed service will keep their existing schools as a regional campus. To do so, the Korea Military Academy — the Army college — will move out of Seoul and be relocated to a site in the central-western region of Chungcheong. The Navy Academy and the Air Force Academy will stay in their current locations -- in the southern coastal county of Jinhae and the central provincial city of Cheongju, respectively. "For specialized training during the second and third years, it is more efficient to keep the Navy and Air Force academies at their current locations, but we needed to find a new location for the Army academy," Rep. Kim Byung-joo told reporters after a policy coordination meeting between party and government officials. The exact relocation site for the Army academy in the Chungcheong region has yet to be decided, Kim added. The revised plan will adopt a so-called 1-2-1 model, where cadets complete shared coursework in their first and final years at the joint military academy and spend their second and third years for branch-specific training at their respective schools. The revision also includes a plan to establish a new graduate school for master's and doctoral courses at the main campus to offer a path for in-depth military education, the defense ministry said in release. The government plans to apply the new system to cadets entering in 2029, with each military branch continuing to recruit cadets separately until then to minimize confusion. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul expressed his commitment to establishing the combined academy to nurture creative talent capable of breaking away from conventional educational frameworks. "By having Army, Navy and Air Force cadets train together and unite as a single warrior community, we will foster them into key leaders of our military capable of prevailing on any battlefield," Kang said during the meeting. Kang also stressed the need to set a "clear and bold direction," while reviewing the implementation process in a "thorough and prudent" manner. The new military academy will operate directly under the ministry, unlike the existing academies that fall under each individual armed service, the ministry said, citing the need for a "consistent and balanced" management and oversight in budget and other related policies. The revised plan marks a retreat from an initial July proposal to merge the three service academies into a single institution inside the Jaundae compound and close down the existing schools. Amid growing opposition to the plan, Kang, a retired Army general, had signaled an adjustment to the initial framework, highlighting that the move is not aimed at abolishing the three academies. Alumni groups have denounced the planned integration as an attempt to weaken the core identity and capabilities of each military branch. Army college graduates, in particular, have argued that it was a politically driven move by the Lee Jae Myung administration to curb the Army's influence over its involvement in past military coups and the short-lived martial law attempt by former President Yoon Suk Yeol in 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 执政党和政府公布修订后的方案，将陆军士官学校迁往忠清地区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）和政府周三表示，将把陆军士官学校迁至忠清中部地区，海军和空军士官学校则维持原址，并修改此前将三校合并为统一军校的方案。修订后的方案保留了在位于大田市中心的驻在台军事基地设立联合学校的最初提议；大田位于首尔以南约140公里，但各军种仍将以地区分校区形式保留现有学校。为此，韩国陆军士官学校将迁出首尔，迁至忠清中西部的某个地点。海军士官学校和空军士官学校将分别继续设在南部沿海的镇海和忠清道的省会清州。执政党与政府官员举行政策协调会议后，议员金炳周对记者说：“二、三年级进行专业训练时，让海军和空军士官学校留在现址更为高效，但我们需要为陆军士官学校寻找新地点。”金补充说，陆军士官学校迁往忠清地区的具体地点尚未确定。修订后的方案将采用所谓的“1-2-1模式”：学员在联合军校完成第一学年和最后一学年的共同课程，第二和第三学年则分别在各自学校接受军种专业训练。国防部在一份声明中说，修订方案还包括在主校区设立新的研究生院，开设硕士和博士课程，为深入军事教育提供途径。政府计划从2029年入学的学员开始实施新制度，在此之前，各军种将继续分别招收学员，以尽量减少混乱。国防部长姜善淳表示，他致力于建立综合性军校，培养能够摆脱传统教育框架的创新型人才。姜在会上说：“让陆军、海军和空军学员共同训练，并团结为一个统一的武士共同体，我们将把他们培养成能够在任何战场上取得胜利的军队中坚领导力量。”他还强调，需要确立“明确而大胆的方向”，并以“全面而审慎”的方式审查实施过程。国防部表示，与现有士官学校分别隶属于各军种不同，新军校将由国防部直接管辖；国防部称，此举是为了确保预算及其他相关政策得到“一致且均衡”的管理和监督。修订后的方案意味着放弃7月最初提出的方案，即把三所军种士官学校合并为驻在台园区内的一所机构，并关闭现有学校。随着反对该计划的呼声日益高涨，退役陆军上将姜善淳曾表示将调整最初框架，强调此举并非旨在废除三所士官学校。校友团体谴责拟议中的整合是企图削弱各军种的核心认同和能力。陆军士官学校毕业生尤其认为，这是李在明政府出于政治目的推动的动作，意在遏制陆军的影响力，尤其是其与过去军事政变以及前总统尹锡悦2024年短暂戒严尝试之间的关联。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 酒店运营商周四表示，Lotte Hotels & Resorts周一在韩国的Signiel Seoul酒店为其年度泡菜制作活动邀请了各国大使，向外交官介绍韩国的传统饮食文化及分享精神，为周日泡菜日作准备。该活动现已进入第二年，汇集了35位驻韩大使，体验韩国传统冬季泡菜制作与分享习俗“kimjang”；该习俗于2013年被联合国教科文组织认定为非物质文化遗产。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Lotte Hotels & Resorts hosted its annual kimchi-making event for foreign ambassadors in Korea at its Signiel Seoul hotel on Monday, introducing the diplomats to Korea's traditional food culture and spirit of sharing ahead of Kimchi Day on Sunday, the hotel operator said Thursday. Now in its second year, the event brought together 35 ambassadors to Korea to experience "kimjang," Korea's traditional winter kimchi-making and sharing practice, which was recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage in 2013. Lotte said the program showed Korea's spirit of sharing, with neighbors coming together to prepare food for winter. After making the kimchi, participants received a portion of their freshly made batch packed in "onggi," traditional Korean earthenware jars, so they could enjoy it at home. Lotte Hotels & Resorts plans to collect photos of the ambassadors pairing the kimchi with their respective cuisines to create a commemorative album. The remaining kimchi will be stored and fermented separately to be served at a welcoming dinner for newly appointed ambassadors in January, they added. Following the hands-on session, the diplomats were treated to a special Korean dinner featuring classic kimjang-season dishes such as "suyuk" (boiled pork slices) paired with fresh kimchi, white rice and mallow soybean paste soup. The menu also incorporated seasonal local ingredients, including porridge made with rice and seasonal vegetables, as well as yuzu mousse and Sancheong strawberry tarts. "It is deeply meaningful that so many ambassadors joined us again this year to directly experience traditional Korean culinary culture and the value of sharing," a Lotte Hotels & Resorts official said. "We will continue to communicate and expand exchanges with foreign envoys through various programs that promote Korean culture." Lotte Hotels & Resorts has been actively engaging with the diplomatic community through culinary programs. In April, it invited envoys from around 20 nations to the Grand Lotte Seoul hotel for a hands-on session making "gujeolpan," a traditional royal court dish served on a platter of nine sectioned plates, followed by a Korean banquet
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 乐天酒店与度假村为外国大使举办泡菜制作活动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 乐天酒店与度假村于周一在位于韩国的首尔新乐天酒店（Signiel Seoul）为其驻韩外国大使举办年度泡菜制作活动，向外交官介绍韩国的传统饮食文化和分享精神，以迎接周日的泡菜节。该酒店运营商周四表示，这项活动现已进入第二年，35位驻韩大使齐聚一堂，体验韩国传统冬季泡菜制作与分享习俗“泡菜节”。这一习俗于2013年被联合国教科文组织列为非物质文化遗产。乐天表示，该项目展现了韩国的分享精神，邻里携手准备过冬食物。制作完泡菜后，参与者获赠一部分 freshly made 批次，并装入韩国传统陶土罐“onggi”中，以便带回家品尝。乐天酒店与度假村计划收集大使将泡菜与各自国家美食搭配的照片，制作纪念相册。他们补充说，剩余泡菜将分别储藏和发酵，用于1月为新任大使举行的欢迎晚宴。动手制作活动结束后，外交官们享用了一顿特别的韩国晚餐，菜单包括“suyuk”（白切猪肉片）等经典泡菜季菜肴，搭配新鲜泡菜、白米和黏性黄豆酱汤。菜单还融入了时令本地食材，包括用大米和时令蔬菜熬成的粥，以及柚子慕斯和三清草莓挞。乐天酒店与度假村一名官员表示：“今年有这么多大使再次加入我们，亲身体验韩国传统饮食文化和分享的价值，这具有深远意义。我们将继续通过各项推广韩国文化的项目，与外国使节沟通并扩大交流。”乐天酒店与度假村一直通过烹饪项目积极与外交界互动。今年4月，该酒店邀请了来自约20个国家的使节前往乐天首尔总店参加动手制作“gujeolpan”的活动。这道传统宫廷菜肴盛放在分为九格的长盘上，随后举行了一场韩国宴会

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A bill calling for official recognition and welfare benefits for more victims of pro-democracy movements was brought before a parliamentary plenary session Thursday. The bill, tabled by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), was immediately met with a filibuster by the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) during the plenary session. The bill is expected to be put to a vote Friday afternoon after the 24-hour filibuster ends. The Democratic Merit Act calls for providing official recognition and benefits to 635 people who were killed, went missing or suffered injuries during pro-democracy movements, including the 1979 Busan-Masan protests and the June 10 democracy uprising in 1987. It seeks to give recognition to victims of past pro-democracy movements who are not covered by current laws, which honor those involved in the April 19 democratic uprising in 1960 and the 1980 pro-democracy movement in the southwestern city of Gwangju. The bill previously passed the National Assembly in 2024, but it was ultimately scrapped after then President Yoon Suk Yeol exercised his veto right. The PPP has opposed the bill, arguing it lacks both public consensus and clear eligibility criteria, and has called on the DPK to immediately halt its push for the bill's passage

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一项呼吁向更多支持民主运动受害者提供官方认定和福利保障的法案于周四提交议会全体会议审议。该法案由执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）提出，但在全体会议期间立即遭到主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）以冗长辩论阻挠。预计24小时的阻挠结束后，该法案将于周五下午付诸表决。《民主功勋法》要求向在支持民主运动中丧生、失踪或受伤的635人提供官方认定和福利保障，其中包括1979年釜山—马山抗议以及1987年6月10日民主起义。法案 seeks to 给予现行法律未涵盖的往届支持民主运动受害者官方认定；现行法律表彰的是参与1960年4月19日民主起义以及1980年位于西南部城市光州的支持民主运动人士。该法案曾于2024年通过国会，但时任总统尹锡悦最终行使否决权后，法案被废止。国民力量党反对该法案，称其既缺乏公众共识，也没有明确的资格标准，并敦促朝鲜民主党立即停止推动该法案通过……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Global higher education experts are urging universities to embrace artificial intelligence (AI) as a catalyst for change rather than a threat, calling for a fundamental rethink of how students are assessed. But for high-stakes exams such as Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), where traditional testing methods are difficult to replace, they stress the need for greater investment in technology to detect AI-assisted cheating.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 全球高等教育专家敦促各大学将人工智能视为推动变革的催化剂，而非威胁，并呼吁从根本上重新思考学生评估方式。但对于韩国大学修业能力测试（CSAT）这类传统测试方法难以替代的高风险考试，他们强调，必须加大技术投入，以侦测借助人工智能实施的作弊行为。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Global higher education experts are urging universities to embrace artificial intelligence (AI) as a catalyst for change rather than a threat, calling for a fundamental rethink of how students are assessed. But for high-stakes exams such as Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), where traditional testing methods are difficult to replace, they stress the need for greater investment in technology to detect AI-assisted cheating. Korea has been gripped by growing fears of AI-assisted cheating, as concerns over the misuse of smart glasses and other wearable devices spread beyond the CSAT to university admissions, campus exams and professional licensing tests. Kuancheng Huang, a professor at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University in Taiwan, called for greater investment in technology to detect AI-assisted cheating, particularly in high-stakes exams. Huang visited Seoul to attend the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University. "Just invest in technology to prevent this from happening because that's so important," Huang told The Korea Times. Although cheating devices are becoming increasingly sophisticated, he said the technology to counter them is available, making the challenge largely a question of how much authorities are willing to spend. While stronger detection measures may be needed for standardized exams, experts also called on universities to rethink how they evaluate students in the AI era. Huang suggested shifting the focus from final answers to students' reasoning and problem-solving processes, arguing that traditional assessments are becoming less effective at measuring students' actual abilities as AI tools grow more sophisticated. John Kao, president of National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, echoed the need for a new approach, arguing that restricting emerging technologies would do little to prevent cheating. "Cheating has been around from the beginning of time. It's just now the tools are getting more sophisticated," Kao said. Kao said the university requires students and faculty to disclose their use of AI, comparing the practice to citing sources in academic research. Dawn Freshwater, executive director of the Worldwide Universities Network, also urged universities to embrace AI as an inevitable part of education while ensuring students develop the critical thinking and ethical judgment needed to use it responsibly. "We have to accept that students will be working and living in a world that is surrounded with AI, immersed in AI," she said. She emphasized that universities must teach students to think independently and produce original work, using AI to support their ideas rather than replace them. "Original thought augmented by AI but not driven by AI," she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 全球专家 amid 作弊担忧：拥抱人工智能，但应投资开发高风险考试作弊检测技术
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 全球高等教育专家敦促大学将人工智能视为推动变革的催化剂，而非威胁，并呼吁从根本上重新思考学生评估方式。但对于韩国大学修业能力测试（CSAT）等传统测试方法难以替代的高风险考试，他们强调需要加大技术投入，以侦测借助人工智能实施的作弊。随着人们对滥用智能眼镜及其他可穿戴设备的担忧从CSAT蔓延至大学招生、校园考试和职业资格考试，韩国正深陷人工智能辅助作弊恐慌。台湾阳明交通大学教授黄冠成呼吁加大技术投入，侦测借助人工智能实施的作弊，尤其是在高风险考试中。黄冠成赴首尔出席2026年《泰晤士高等教育》创新与影响力峰会，该活动在韩国大学举行。黄冠成告诉《韩国时报》：“一定要投资技术来防止此类行为，因为这件事太重要了。”他表示，尽管作弊设备正变得越来越先进，但应对这些设备的技术已经存在，因此挑战主要在于当局愿意投入多少资金。尽管标准化考试可能需要采取更强的侦测措施，专家也呼吁大学重新思考人工智能时代的学生评估方式。黄冠成建议将评估重点从最终答案转向学生的推理和解决问题过程，认为随着人工智能工具日益先进，传统评估在衡量学生实际能力方面正变得日益无效。台湾清华大学校长高约翰赞同采用新方法，认为限制新兴技术几乎无法阻止作弊。高约翰说：“作弊自古以来就存在，只是现在工具变得更先进了。”高约翰表示，该校要求学生和教员披露其人工智能使用情况，并将这一做法与学术研究中的引用来源相类比。世界大学网络执行主任Dawn Freshwater也敦促大学接受人工智能，将其视为教育中不可避免的一部分，同时确保学生培养负责任地使用人工智能所需的批判性思维和伦理判断。她说：“我们必须接受，学生将在一个由人工智能包围、沉浸于人工智能之中的世界工作和生活。”她强调，大学必须教会学生独立思考并创作原创作品，利用人工智能支持自己的想法，而不是取代自己的想法。她说：“原创思想应由人工智能加以强化，而不能由人工智能主导。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Visitors to Korea’s capital now have more time to take in its glittering winter skyline, as city extends evening hours at Seoul City Hall Sky Observatory downtown and opens the panoramic viewing deck on Sundays for the first time this season. The expanded schedule will run from Dec. 11, 2026, through Feb. 9, 2027, coinciding with the Seoul Winter Festa and the operation of the Seoul Plaza ice rink, the Seoul Metropolitan Government said. The observatory, located on the eighth and ninth floors of Seoul City Hall’s main building, will remain open until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday, and until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday. Special hours will allow visitors to stay until midnight on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, while the observatory will close at 10 p.m. on Christmas Day. The observatory will operate from 7:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday, from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Sunday. The extended schedule is intended to give residents and tourists more opportunities to enjoy views of central Seoul during the busy winter festival period, the city said. The observatory offers free admission and requires no reservations, with views of landmarks including Deoksu Palace and Seoul Anglican Cathedral. Visitors can reach the eighth and ninth floors through a dedicated elevator next to the robot cafe on the first floor of Seoul City Hall’s main building. The expanded hours follow strong public interest since the observatory opened July 7, with 196,494 visitors recorded through Wednesday, according to the city. That amounts to an average of 1,913 visitors per operating day, while the busiest day drew 3,836 people on Oct. 10. Evening visits averaged 2,480 people per day, compared with 1,631 during weekday daytime hours, underscoring the appeal of the nighttime views. The city also plans to hold a visitor contest in December, inviting submissions of photographs, paintings, poems and videos inspired by the observatory and its surrounding views, with awards scheduled for February. Kwak Jong-bin, head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government’s Administrative Bureau, said the observatory had quickly become a popular new viewing destination. “The Sky Observatory has earned the affection of many citizens and tourists in a short period and is establishing itself as a new scenic attraction in Seoul,” Kwak said. “We will extend its opening hours this winter so more citizens and tourists can enjoy the beautiful nighttime views of the city center, and continue developing it into a space that showcases new attractions of Seoul,” he said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔市厅观景台延长晚间开放时间并于周日开放
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国首都的游客如今有更多时间欣赏璀璨的冬季夜景：市政府延长了市中心 Seoul City Hall Sky Observatory（首尔市政厅天空观景台）的晚间开放时间，并在本季首次于星期日开放全景观景平台。首尔市政府表示，延长后的开放时间从 2026 年 12 月 11 日持续至 2027 年 2 月 9 日，与 Seoul Winter Festa（首尔冬季 fest）及 Seoul Plaza（首尔广场）溜冰场运营期重合。该观景台位于 Seoul City Hall（首尔市政厅）主楼的第八和第九层，周一至周四及周日常至晚上 9 点开放，周五和周六则开放至晚上 10 点。平安夜和除夕将实行特别延长开放时间，游客可停留至午夜；圣诞节当天，观景台于晚上 10 点关闭。观景台的正常开放时间为：周一至周四上午 7 点 30 分至晚上 9 点，周五和周六上午 9 点至晚上 10 点，周日上午 10 点至晚上 9 点。市政府表示，延长开放时间旨在冬日节庆活动繁忙期间，为市民和游客提供更多欣赏首尔市中心景观的机会。观景台免费开放，无需预约，游客可观赏包括 Deoksu Palace（德寿宫）和 Seoul Anglican Cathedral（首尔圣公会大教堂）在内的多处地标。游客可乘坐 Seoul City Hall（首尔市政厅）主楼一层机器人咖啡馆旁的专用电梯抵达第八和第九层。市政府称，自 7 月 7 日开放以来，公众反响热烈，截至周三共接待 196,494 名游客，平均每个开放日为 1,913 人；最繁忙的一天是 10 月 10 日，共有 3,836 人到访。晚间参观人数平均为每日 2,480 人，而工作日日间为 1,631 人，凸显夜间景观的吸引力。市政府还计划于 12 月举办游客征集活动，欢迎参与者提交以观景台及其周边景色为灵感创作的照片、绘画、诗歌和视频，颁奖仪式定于 2 月举行。首尔市政府行政局长官 Kwak Jong-bin 表示，该观景台迅速成为热门的新观景目的地。Kwak 说：“Sky Observatory（天空观景台）在很短时间内便赢得了众多市民和游客的喜爱，正在成为首尔一处新兴风景景点。我们将在今年冬季延长其开放时间，让更多市民和游客欣赏市中心美丽的夜景，并继续将其打造成为展示首尔新亮点的空间。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由 The Korea Times 编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: After more than a decade in rented quarters, the Korean Cultural Center in Thailand has opened a permanent five-story headquarters in Bangkok, expanding its stage to meet growing Thai interest in Korean culture. The center will hold its reopening ceremony Thursday at 5 p.m. (local time), welcoming about 100 officials and representatives from the cultural, artistic, business and media sectors of Korea and Thailand. Located on Sukhumvit Road, one of Bangkok's busiest commercial districts, the 1,906-square-meter building is the 14th Korean cultural center overseas to move into state-owned premises. The center, which opened in 2013, previously faced limitations because its leased facilities lacked a proper performance hall and sufficient classrooms. The new building houses a traditional culture room and lounge on the first floor, a Korean food experience center on the second, dance studios and classrooms on the third, a library on the fourth, and performance and exhibition spaces on the fifth. Its performance hall features 140 retractable seats and a 271-inch LED stage screen, while four specialized classrooms will accommodate programs covering Korean cuisine, traditional music, dance and visual arts. Visitors will also see "A Landscape carried by Wishes," an immersive media art exhibition presenting two works inspired by the tiger, a symbol of protection and courage in both Korean and Thai cultures. "Thailand is a country in Southeast Asia where K-culture is widely loved and, at the same time, an important partner in cultural cooperation with a rich cultural heritage and a dynamic creative industry," said Kim Jae-hyun, director general of the Culture and Media Industry Bureau at Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 在租赁场所运营十余年后，驻泰国韩国文化中心已在曼谷启用一座永久性五层总部大楼，以扩大舞台，满足泰国公众日益浓厚的韩国文化兴趣。该中心将于当地时间周四下午5点举行重新启用仪式，邀请约100名韩国和泰国文化、艺术、商业及媒体领域的官员和代表出席。大楼位于素坤逸路，这是曼谷最繁忙的商业区之一，建筑面积1,906平方米，是第14座迁入国有场所的海外韩国文化中心。该中心于2013年启用，此前因租赁设施缺少适当的演出厅和足够的教室而受到限制。新大楼一层设有传统文化室和休息室，二层设有韩国美食体验中心，三层设有舞蹈工作室和教室，四层设有图书馆，五层设有演出和展览空间。其演出厅配备140个可伸缩座椅和一块271英寸LED舞台屏幕，另有4间专用教室，可容纳涵盖韩国料理、传统音乐、舞蹈和视觉艺术的项目。观众还将欣赏《由愿望承载的风景》沉浸式媒体艺术展，展览呈现两件以老虎为灵感创作的作品；老虎在韩国和泰国文化中都是保护与勇气的象征。韩国文化体育观光部文化媒体产业局局长金宰贤表示：“泰国是东南亚一个广受欢迎韩流文化的国家，同时也是韩国开展文化合作的重要伙伴，拥有深厚的文化遗产和充满活力的创意产业。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。
