https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title: Korean tenants turn to credit cards for paying rent amid rising housing costs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: A 33-year-old office worker in Seoul’s Yongsan District surnamed Lee signed up for an app that lets her pay rent by credit card, after hearing about the service in a news report. “I’m still weighing whether that’s worth the fee.” Rent payment apps are gaining ground as housing costs rise, particularly in Seoul, and more landlords switch from "jeonse," or large lump-sum leases, to monthly rentals.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 首尔龙山区一名33岁、姓李的办公室职员在新闻报道中得知一项可用信用卡支付房租的服务后，便注册了相关应用。“我仍在权衡这项服务是否值得收取费用。”随着住房成本上涨，尤其是首尔，租金支付应用正日益普及，越来越多房东也从“全租”（即一次性支付大额租金的长期租赁）转为按月出租。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: A 33-year-old office worker in Seoul’s Yongsan District surnamed Lee signed up for an app that lets her pay rent by credit card, after hearing about the service in a news report. Rent takes up a large share of her monthly budget, she said, and having enough cash on hand by the due date can be stressful. “I like that paying by card buys me time until the bill comes due,” Lee said. “I’m still weighing whether that’s worth the fee.” Rent payment apps are gaining ground as housing costs rise, particularly in Seoul, and more landlords switch from "jeonse," or large lump-sum leases, to monthly rentals. The services allow renters who are short on cash to cover their rent if they have enough available credit, but some providers charge fees exceeding 7 percent of the payment amount. Reports of landlords failing to receive rent on time even after tenants have paid by card have also raised consumer protection concerns. The average monthly rent for a Seoul apartment reached 1.68 million won ($1,260) in October, up 190,000 won from the end of last year, according to the Korea Real Estate Board. Over the same period, average monthly rent in low-rise multifamily homes rose by 42,000 won to 684,000 won. Homes Pay and Zipup Pay have each surpassed 10,000 downloads on Google Play. Kim Ki-tae, CEO of DEVD, which operates Zipup Pay, told a local media outlet that the idea grew out of a simple question: If people could pay for meals and transportation by credit card, why did they still have to pay rent, often their biggest monthly expense, by bank transfer? New providers are also entering the market. Lanseon Pay, which launched its app last month, lets tenants pay rent in installments over a period of up to 24 months. Users enter the recipient’s bank account number and the amount they want to send, then pay by credit card. The company says the money typically reaches the recipient’s account in about five minutes. Credit card issuers introduced their own rent payment services in 2019 after the Financial Services Commission designated card-based rent payments as an innovative financial service under its regulatory sandbox. Those services require landlords to register with the issuer in much the same way merchants do. The newer apps charge the tenant’s card for the rent plus a service fee, then transfer the rent to the landlord’s bank account. Providers say tenants can use the apps without seeking their landlord’s consent or asking them to register. Rent payment services typically charge between 2 and 4 percent, with some providers charging 7 percent or more. For a tenant paying Seoul’s average apartment rent, that translates to about 67,000 won in fees at 4 percent, or nearly 118,000 won at 7 percent. Paying by card also leaves tenants dependent on the provider to complete the transfer. In one online community post, a tenant reported paying two months’ rent by credit card through a rent payment service and receiving a payment demand from the landlord after the transfer was delayed. The services also raise questions about how they handle landlords’ personal information. One issue is whether providers meet legal requirements for collecting and using landlords’ bank account details when tenants enter them into an app
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 住房成本上涨之际，韩国租户转用信用卡支付房租
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 首尔龙山区一名33岁的办公室职员李女士在新闻报道中了解到一项可用信用卡支付房租的应用服务后，便注册使用。她说，房租占其每月预算的很大一部分，而确保到期日手头有足够现金会让人压力很大。李女士说：“我喜欢用信用卡支付，这样可以让我在账单到期前获得缓冲时间。”“我仍在考虑这是否值得支付手续费。”随着住房成本上涨，尤其是首尔住房成本攀升，房租支付应用正日益普及，越来越多房东也从“全租制”，即一次性支付大额租金的租赁方式，转向按月出租。这些服务让手头现金不足的租客在可用信用额度充足时支付房租，但部分服务商的收费超过支付金额的7%。有报道称，即使租客已通过信用卡付款，房东仍未按时收到房租，这也引发了消费者保护方面的担忧。据韩国不动产委员会数据，首尔公寓平均月租在10月达到168万韩元（1,260美元），较去年年底上涨19万韩元。同期，低层多户住宅的平均月租上涨4.2万韩元，达到68.4万韩元。Homes Pay和Zipup Pay在Google Play上的下载量均已超过1万次。运营Zipup Pay的DEVD首席执行官金基泰对当地媒体表示，这一想法源于一个简单的问题：如果人们可以用信用卡支付餐饮和交通费用，为什么支付往往是每月最大支出的房租时，仍必须通过银行转账？新的服务商也在进入市场。上个月推出应用的Lanseon Pay允许租客在最长24个月内分期支付房租。用户输入收款方的银行账号和要汇出的金额，随后用信用卡付款。该公司称，资金通常约在5分钟内到账。2019年，在金融服务委员会将基于信用卡的房租支付认定为监管沙盒机制下的创新金融服务后，信用卡发行机构推出了各自的房租支付服务。这些服务要求房东像商户一样在发行机构注册。新款应用会从租客的信用卡中扣除房租和服务费，然后将房租转入房东的银行账户。服务商称，租客无需征得房东同意，也无需让房东注册，即可使用这些应用。房租支付服务通常收取2%至4%的费用，部分服务商的收费达到7%或更高。对于支付首尔公寓平均租金的租客而言，按4%计算约需支付6.7万韩元手续费，按7%计算则接近11.8万韩元。使用信用卡付款还会让租客依赖服务商完成转账。在一个网络社区帖子中，一名租客称通过房租支付服务用信用卡支付了两个月房租，却因转账延迟而收到房东的付款要求。这些服务也引发了如何处理房东个人信息的问题。其中一个问题在于，当租客将房东的银行账户信息输入应用时，服务商是否满足收集和使用这些信息的法律要求

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea's research rising, but universities must break down silos: WUN chief
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Dawn Freshwater, executive director of the Worldwide Universities Network (WUN), made the remarks in an interview with The Korea Times Thursday, during the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University in Seoul. WUN is a consortium of research-intensive universities across six continents that funds and supports international research collaboration among its members.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 全球大学网络（WUN）执行主任道恩·弗雷什沃特在周四接受《韩国时报》采访时发表上述言论；此次采访是在首尔韩国大学举行的《泰晤士高等教育》2026年创新与影响力峰会期间进行的。全球大学网络是由六大洲研究型大学组成的联盟，为成员之间的国际研究合作提供资金和支持。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Dawn Freshwater, executive director of the Worldwide Universities Network (WUN), made the remarks in an interview with The Korea Times Thursday, during the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University in Seoul. WUN is a consortium of research-intensive universities across six continents that funds and supports international research collaboration among its members. Freshwater said universities have long been cut off from government, industry and business. They have tried to produce graduates who are ready for work, she said, but their research has not always done as much to advance society and industry. “The fourth generation of university is now teaching, research and innovation for societal impact,” she said, describing how universities moved from teaching alone, to teaching and research, then to innovation and now to delivering benefits for society. A fourth-generation university acts as a driver of regional innovation, combining education, research and innovation to solve real-world social and economic problems. To make that shift, she said, universities need strong ties with industry, business and government. They can also learn from how institutions in other countries work with technology institutes and businesses to raise the economic value of a university education. Asked how visible Korean universities are in global research networks, Freshwater said it is “all relative.” It is very difficult to match the scale of research and development spending in the United States, where much of the money comes from large companies, philanthropists and alumni. “But I actually think Korea is really on an upward trajectory from a research point of view,” she said, citing the high quality of Korean students and talent. She said her former schools had worked with Korean partners, pointing to Korea University’s Climate Corps program. Through the program, foreign students join Korean students in climate-related activities and learn about research and graduate study opportunities in Korea. On geopolitical tension, Freshwater said universities mostly stay neutral, which lets them run cross-border projects across disciplines, such as cancer research that is now aiming for cures rather than only treatment. She acknowledged that governments take different positions on data sovereignty, meaning national control over where data is stored and how it is shared. Universities therefore need to work closely with governments to understand national priorities and limits. “This is not the first time that we’ve been in difficult geopolitical contexts, and we’ve navigated our way through it,” she said, adding that higher education can serve as a broker of knowledge and a channel for soft diplomacy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国科研实力不断上升，但各大学必须打破机构壁垒——世界大学网络主席称
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 世界大学网络（WUN）执行主任Dawn Freshwater星期四接受《韩国时报》采访时发表上述言论；当时正值2026年《泰晤士高等教育》创新与影响力峰会于首尔高丽大学举行。WUN是由六大洲研究型大学组成的联盟，为成员之间的国际研究合作提供资金和支持。Freshwater表示，长期以来，大学与政府、实业界和商业界相互隔绝。她表示，各大学一直努力培养做好就业准备的毕业生，但它们的研究未必总能为社会和产业发展带来同等程度的推动。 她说：“第四代大学如今围绕社会影响开展教学、研究和创新。”她解释道，大学从单纯教学，发展到教学与研究并存，再到创新，如今则致力于为社会带来效益。第四代大学是区域创新的推动力量，将教育、研究与创新相结合，以解决现实世界中的社会和经济问题。她表示，要实现这一转变，大学需要与实业界、商业界和政府建立紧密联系。它们还可以借鉴其他国家各机构与技术研究院和企业合作、提高大学教育经济价值的做法。被问及韩国大学在全球研究网络中的可见程度时，Freshwater表示，这“要视情况而定”。要达到美国研究与开发支出的规模非常困难，因为美国的大量资金来自大型企业、慈善家和校友。 她说：“但从研究的角度来看，我确实认为韩国正处于上升轨道。”她提到韩国学生和人才的高素质。她说，她曾任职的学校曾与韩国伙伴合作，并举例称高丽大学的Climate Corps项目。通过该项目，外国学生与韩国学生一同参与气候相关活动，并了解韩国的研究及研究生学习机会。谈及地缘政治紧张局势，Freshwater表示，大学大多保持中立立场，因此能够开展跨越学科的跨境项目，例如目前正致力于寻找治愈方法而非仅仅提供治疗的癌症研究。她承认，各国政府对数据主权持不同立场；数据主权是指由国家控制数据存储地点及数据共享方式。因此，大学需要与政府密切合作，以了解国家的重点事项和限制。 她说：“这不是我们第一次身处困难的地缘政治环境，我们已经摸索着走过来了。”她补充称，高等教育可以充当知识中介和软实力外交的渠道

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: P&G Korea donates 20,000 diapers to support vulnerable families
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: P&G Korea, the local unit of U.S. consumer goods giant Procter & Gamble, is donating 20,000 Pampers diapers to families facing financial and social hardships, extending its support for vulnerable children and single-parent households ahead of the year-end holiday season.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 美国消费品巨头宝洁公司的韩国子公司P&G Korea正向面临经济和社会困境的家庭捐赠20,000片帮宝适纸尿裤；在年终假期季到来前，该公司继续向弱势儿童和单亲家庭伸出援手。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: P&G Korea, the local unit of U.S. consumer goods giant Procter & Gamble, is donating 20,000 Pampers diapers to families facing financial and social hardships, extending its support for vulnerable children and single-parent households ahead of the year-end holiday season. The donation was made through the Salvation Army Kettle Campaign, with the diapers set to be distributed to Duri Home, a residential facility for single-parent families, other Salvation Army childcare facilities and households raising young children in need. Duri Home provides accommodation and support for single parents raising children younger than 3, helping families establish stable living conditions while preparing for independent lives. Alongside the donation, employees from P&G Korea's Pampers team visited Duri Home on Nov. 12 to volunteer in childcare and facility maintenance, helping create a more comfortable environment for children and their caregivers. "Diapers are an essential everyday necessity for families raising young children, and we hope this donation will ease some of their financial burden and provide practical support for children's healthy development," said Rohini Venkateswaran, president of P&G Korea. "P&G Korea will continue to contribute to local communities by providing support where it is needed, so that every child can grow up in a healthy and stable environment," she said. The latest contribution builds on the company's longstanding community outreach through Pampers, which has donated more than 32,000 boxes of diapers to disadvantaged families since 2017. Since 2018, P&G Korea has also partnered with the Kids and Future Foundation on its Family Care campaign, working to improve medical environments for pediatric patients. Last year, Pampers employees volunteered at Seoul Medical Center following the completion of renovations to its pediatric ward, continuing the company's efforts to support children and their families beyond product donations. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 宝洁韩国捐赠2万片纸尿裤，支持弱势家庭
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: P&G Korea是美国消费品巨头宝洁公司（Procter & Gamble）的韩国分支机构。在年末 holiday season（节日季）到来之际，该机构向正面临经济和社会困境的家庭捐赠20,000片帮宝适纸尿裤，以继续支持弱势儿童和单亲家庭。此次捐赠通过救世军募捐锅活动（Salvation Army Kettle Campaign）进行，纸尿裤将分发给Duri Home——一家面向单亲家庭的住宿和照护机构——以及救世军旗下其他儿童照护机构和抚养年幼儿童且有需要的家庭。Duri Home为抚养3岁以下儿童的单亲家长提供住宿和支持，帮助家庭建立稳定的生活条件，同时为独立生活做好准备。除此次捐赠外，P&G Korea帮宝适团队的员工还于11月12日探访Duri Home，志愿参与儿童照护和设施维护，帮助为儿童及其照护者营造更舒适的环境。P&G Korea总裁Rohini Venkateswaran表示：“纸尿裤是抚养年幼儿童的家庭每天必不可少的必需品，我们希望这次捐赠能减轻他们部分经济负担，并为儿童健康成长提供实际支持。”她说：“P&G Korea将继续通过在最需要的地方提供支持，为当地社区作出贡献，让每个孩子都能在健康、稳定的环境中成长。”此次捐赠延续了公司通过帮宝适品牌长期开展社区公益行动的做法。自2017年以来，帮宝适已向弱势家庭捐赠超过32,000箱纸尿裤。自2018年以来，P&G Korea还与儿童与未来基金会合作开展“家庭关怀”活动，致力于改善儿科患者的医疗环境。去年，在首尔医疗中心完成儿科病房翻修后，帮宝适员工曾到该院从事志愿服务，继续公司在产品捐赠之外支持儿童及其家庭的工作。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: Korean tech giants take different paths in humanoid robot race
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: Samsung focuses on precision hand, LG highlights versatility in humanoid biz Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics are pursuing markedly different strategies in the robotics market, and the contrast is expected to become more apparent as the two companies showcase their latest technologies and visions at CES 2027.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 三星聚焦精密手部技术，LG强调人形机器人业务的多功能性。三星电子和LG电子在机器人市场采取了截然不同的战略，随着两家公司在CES 2027上展示最新技术和愿景，这种对比预计将更加明显。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Samsung focuses on precision hand, LG highlights versatility in humanoid biz Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics are pursuing markedly different strategies in the robotics market, and the contrast is expected to become more apparent as the two companies showcase their latest technologies and visions at CES 2027. According to industry officials on Thursday, Samsung Electronics is focusing on precise control of robotic hands and arms, as dexterity is considered one of the most critical capabilities for expanding the practical applications of humanoid robots. Unlike conventional robots, whose role was repeating a single rigid motion, humanoid robots are required to perform various work in constantly changing real-world environments. This requires them to go beyond simply grasping and moving objects to handling a wide range of tools and components with precision. The challenge becomes even greater when dealing with delicate and fragile components, which demand increasingly precise control of robotic fingers and arms. To achieve this, Samsung Electronics' newly established Robotics Experience Division is reportedly focusing on tendon-driven technologies that use actuator-powered cables and pulleys to enable precise control of robotic fingers and joints. Humanoid robotic hands can be categorized based on their actuation mechanisms. Tesla, for example, employs a tendon-driven system that moves finger joints through cables resembling tendons in the human hand. On the other hand, Boston Dynamics places actuators directly at individual joints. Tendon-driven systems offer the advantage of lighter fingers, but their cables are subject to wear and require replacement. Joint-level actuation systems, meanwhile, offer precise motion control but face challenges related to motor weight and heat generation. Samsung Electronics appears to be exploring a tendon-inspired approach that combines motor-driven cables with active and passive pulleys to coordinate finger movements. According to a patent application published in October, the system uses actuators housed in the palm to drive individual fingers, while connected pulleys help coordinate movements across multiple joints. Last month, Samsung Electronics Executive Chairman Lee Jae-yong visited the Robotics Experience Division at the company's research and development campus in Seoul, where he reportedly reviewed progress in the development of robotic hand technologies. The company is also conducting research on world models, which predict changes in surrounding environments, and related robot foundation models. Samsung Electronics plans to leverage its network of more than 100 factories and production lines to test robots' ability to perform real-world tasks and further refine their capabilities. LG Electronics, which first showcased its CLOiD robot in January, is now focusing on its industrial applications. Although CLOiD currently uses a wheeled base, industry officials expect the company to unveil a bipedal humanoid version amid CES 2027. During its initial showcase at CES 2026 in January, the company positioned CLOiD as a home humanoid robot, demonstrating its ability to perform household chores such as folding laundry and retrieving ingredients. However, LG Electronics is now considering expanding its applications into industrial sites first. The company recently said it is deploying CLOiD at its washing machine plant in Tennessee to test the robot’s ability to transport washing machine top panels and sort and stack components. LG Electronics is also working with Nvidia to establish a system for collecting approximately 500,000 hours of robot training data by combining real-world and simulated data. “LG Electronics' strength lies in its ability to secure early demand in both the manufacturing and R&D markets,” Daol Securities analyst Kim Yeon-mi said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国科技巨头在人形机器人竞赛中各辟蹊径
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 三星聚焦机器人手部精密控制，LG突出人形机器人业务的多功能性。三星电子和LG电子在机器人市场采取了明显不同的策略，随着两家公司CES 2027展示最新技术和愿景，这一对比预计会更加明显。据业内人士周四表示，三星电子正专注于对机器人手部和手臂进行精密控制，因为灵巧性被视为扩大人形机器人实际应用的最关键能力之一。传统机器人的作用是重复单一且固定的动作，而人形机器人则需要在不断变化的现实环境中完成各种工作。这就要求它们不能只是抓取和移动物体，还要精确操作种类广泛的工具和零部件。面对精细易碎的零部件时，挑战会进一步加大，因为这些零部件要求对机器人手指和手臂实施越来越精密的控制。为此，据报道，三星电子新成立的机器人体验部门正专注于研究腱驱动技术，利用执行器驱动的缆绳和滑轮，实现对机器人手指和关节的精密控制。人形机器人手可以按照驱动机制进行分类。例如，Tesla采用腱驱动系统，通过类似人体手部肌腱的缆绳驱动指关节。另一方面，Boston Dynamics则将执行器直接安装在各个关节上。腱驱动系统的优势是手指更轻，但其缆绳容易磨损，需要更换。与此同时，关节级驱动系统能够精确控制运动，却面临电机重量和热量产生等问题。三星电子似乎正在探索一种受肌腱启发的方案，将电机驱动缆绳与主动和被动滑轮结合起来，协调手指运动。根据10月份公布的一项专利申请，该系统利用安装在掌心中的执行器驱动各个手指，并通过相互连接的滑轮协调多个关节的运动。上个月，三星电子执行董事长李在镕参观了公司位于首尔的研发园区机器人体验部门，据报道，他在那里听取了机器人手部技术开发进展的汇报。该公司还在研究用于预测周围环境变化的世界模型，以及相关的机器人基础模型。三星电子计划利用其拥有100多家工厂和生产线的网络，测试机器人执行现实任务的能力，并进一步改进其性能。LG电子今年1月首次展示了其CLOiD机器人，目前正专注于其工业应用。尽管CLOiD目前采用轮式底盘，但业内人士预计，该公司将在CES 2027期间发布双足人形版本。在今年1月CES 2026的首次展示中，LG电子将CLOiD定位为家庭人形机器人，并展示了它执行叠衣服、取食材等家务的能力。不过，LG电子目前正考虑首先将应用范围扩展到工业场所。该公司最近表示，正在田纳西州的洗衣机工厂部署CLOiD，以测试该机器人运输洗衣机顶板以及分拣和堆叠零部件的能力。LG电子还在与Nvidia合作建立一套系统，通过结合现实世界数据和模拟数据，收集约500,000小时的机器人训练数据。Daol Securities分析师Kim Yeon-mi表示：“LG电子的优势在于其能够率先争取制造业和研发市场的早期需求。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title: Korea becomes world's 4th country to reach $1 tril. in annual exports
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary: AI-driven semiconductor biggest driver Korea has surpassed $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time in its history, becoming the world's fourth country to reach the milestone after the United States, Germany and China, as a global artificial intelligence (AI) boom drives demand for semiconductors.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 在全球人工智能（AI）热潮推动半导体需求增长的背景下，由人工智能驱动的半导体成为韩国最大的出口驱动力。韩国历史上首次实现年出口额超过1万亿美元，成为继美国、德国和中国之后全球第四个达到这一里程碑的国家。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: AI-driven semiconductor biggest driver Korea has surpassed $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time in its history, becoming the world's fourth country to reach the milestone after the United States, Germany and China, as a global artificial intelligence (AI) boom drives demand for semiconductors. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources announced Thursday that the country's cumulative exports reached the $1 trillion mark at 2:09:38 p.m. The achievement comes 19 years after China reached the milestone in 2007, following the U.S. and Germany in 2006. The government projects annual exports will reach approximately $1.17 trillion this year, following last year's record of $709.3 billion. The ministry explained global technology companies’ expanding AI investments were the biggest driver of export growth, boosting demand for semiconductors and computers while pushing up memory chip prices. Semiconductor exports reached $396.8 billion in the January-October period, almost triple the $135.4 billion recorded in 2025, as the price of memory chips, including DRAM and NAND, climbed. Demand for AI data center infrastructure has also boosted exports of computers, electrical equipment and nonferrous metals, including storage devices, transformers, power cables, copper and aluminum. Higher international oil prices, driven by uncertainty over supplies from the Middle East and Russian export restrictions, lifted the value of petroleum product exports despite limits on gasoline and diesel shipments. The average export price of petroleum products rose 62 percent to $1,105 per ton in the January-October period from $681 a year earlier. Other export industries, including shipbuilding and displays, also performed well, while cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and agricultural and seafood products posted record performances. Cosmetics exports alone reached $12.4 billion in the first 10 months, surpassing their previous full-year record of $11.4 billion. Overall, 16 of 20 major export categories expanded year-on-year, with eight recording their strongest January-October performance ever. Exports excluding semiconductors rose 20 percent in the first 10 months, underscoring growth beyond the chip boom. Seven of the country's nine major export markets also recorded growth. “This is a valuable achievement made possible by Korean companies competing in global markets, businesspeople and workers putting in long hours on the production floor and everyone who has contributed to the country's export efforts,” Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said. However, sustaining the current level of exports will depend on how the country navigates risks, including a potential slowdown in AI investment, semiconductor price volatility, lower oil prices and Chinese oversupply, as well as growing trade barriers in major markets. The ministry also noted that the benefits of export growth may be less visible to the public because semiconductors, petrochemicals and petroleum products generate fewer jobs than shipbuilding and automobile manufacturing. He warned that large trade surpluses could invite further pressure from trading partners, particularly the U.S., and called for stronger investment-based economic partnerships. While Japan's overseas investment offered a point of reference, he said Korea should maintain its domestic manufacturing capabilities while expanding production overseas. “We should not simply follow Japan's path. We need to maintain a substantial domestic production base, including advanced plants and mother factories for research and core production, while also expanding our manufacturing capacity overseas,” he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 韩国成为全球第四个年出口额达到1万亿美元的国家
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh: 在人工智能驱动的半导体产业推动下，韩国历史上首次实现年出口额突破1万亿美元，成为继美国、德国和中国之后全球第四个达到这一里程碑的国家，人工智能在全球范围内的蓬勃发展带动了半导体需求。韩国产业通商资源部周四宣布，该国累计出口额于下午2时09分38秒达到1万亿美元。这一成就距中国于2007年达到该里程碑仅19年，而美国和德国均于2006年率先达到。继去年创下7093亿美元纪录后，政府预计今年出口额将达到约1.17万亿美元。该部表示，全球科技企业不断加码人工智能投资，是出口增长的最大推动因素；这一投资不仅拉动了半导体和计算机需求，也推高了存储芯片价格。1月至10月，半导体出口额达到3968亿美元，接近2025年1354亿美元的三倍，其中DRAM和NAND等存储芯片价格持续上涨。人工智能数据中心基础设施需求也带动了计算机、电气设备和有色金属产品出口，包括存储设备、变压器、电缆、铜和铝。受中东供应不确定以及俄罗斯限制出口影响，国际油价上涨。尽管汽油和柴油运输受到限制，石油产品出口总值仍随之提高。1月至10月，石油产品平均出口价格从一年前的每吨681美元上涨62%至每吨1105美元。造船和显示器等其他出口行业同样表现良好，化妆品、药品以及农产品和水产品也创下佳绩。仅化妆品一项，前10个月出口额便达到124亿美元，超过此前全年114亿美元的纪录。总体而言，20大出口类别中有16类同比扩大，其中8类创下历年1月至10月最佳表现。前10个月，不含半导体的出口额增长20%，表明增长动力已超越芯片热潮。该国9大主要出口市场中有7个实现增长。产业部长金正官表示：“这是韩国企业参与全球竞争、商业人士和生产一线员工辛勤付出，以及所有为韩国出口事业作出贡献的人共同创造的宝贵成就。”不过，能否维持当前出口水平，将取决于韩国如何应对多种风险，包括人工智能投资可能放缓、半导体价格波动、油价下跌、中国产能过剩，以及主要市场贸易壁垒不断增加等。该部还指出，公众可能较难直接感受到出口增长带来的益处，因为半导体、石化和石油产品创造的就业岗位少于造船和汽车制造业。他警告说巨额贸易顺差可能招致贸易伙伴进一步施压，尤其是美国，并呼吁建立以投资为基础的更强经济伙伴关系。他表示，日本的海外投资提供了一种参考，但韩国在扩大海外生产的同时，应维持本土制造能力。他说：“我们不能简单照搬日本的路径。我们需要保有雄厚的本土生产基础，包括用于研发和核心生产的先进工厂及母工厂，同时也要扩大海外制造能力。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Kolmar Group secures Red Bull's Korean distribution rights
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Vice Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun seeks to boost brand's market share through HK inno.N's distribution network Kolmar Group has secured the Korean distribution rights for Red Bull, the world's No. 1 energy drink brand, as Vice Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun seeks to capitalize on the fast-growing market by adding the Austrian brand to HK inno.N's business portfolio.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 副董事长尹相贤 seeks 通过 HK inno.N 的分销网络提升品牌市场份额；Kolmar Group 已取得全球第一大能量饮料品牌红牛在韩国的分销权，副董事长尹相贤希望通过将这个奥地利品牌纳入 HK inno.N 的业务组合，利用快速增长的市场创造价值。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Vice Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun seeks to boost brand's market share through HK inno.N's distribution network Kolmar Group has secured the Korean distribution rights for Red Bull, the world's No. 1 energy drink brand, as Vice Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun seeks to capitalize on the fast-growing market by adding the Austrian brand to HK inno.N's business portfolio. HK inno.N plans to leverage its nationwide distribution network and experience in building Condition, a popular Korean hangover relief drink, into one of the country's leading brands to expand Red Bull's market share. Launched in Austria in 1987, Red Bull sold approximately 14 billion cans worldwide last year, up 10.2 percent from a year earlier. Its revenue rose 8.6 percent to a record 12.2 billion euros ($14.1 billion). The global energy drink market is also expanding rapidly. According to market research firm Grand View Research, the market was valued at $85.3 billion last year and is projected to reach $158.5 billion by 2033, representing an average annual growth rate of 8.1 percent. Korea's energy drink market is also growing strongly despite a slowdown in overall beverage consumption. Lotte Chilsung Beverage's energy drink sales rose 11 percent year-on-year to 107.2 billion won last year, while sales at convenience store chains GS25 and CU increased 26 percent and 18.3 percent, respectively. Once consumed mainly by students studying late at night and office workers putting in overtime, energy drinks are gaining popularity among a broader range of consumers seeking an energy boost for exercise and outdoor activities. According to Embrain Trend Monitor, domestic energy drink purchases rose 14.7 percent from April last year to March this year. Consumers in their 40s recorded the strongest growth at 21.7 percent, followed by those in their 20s at 19.1 percent and those in their 50s at 14.6 percent, indicating that demand is expanding beyond younger consumers. Yoon sees considerable room for Red Bull to expand its presence in Korea despite its global dominance. The brand currently ranks third in the domestic energy drink market. He believes HK inno.N's sales expertise and nationwide convenience store network, developed through its success with Condition, can help strengthen Red Bull's market position. Yoon reportedly took part personally in the final stages of negotiations to secure the distribution rights. This is not Yoon's first strategic move to identify new growth opportunities. HK inno.N, formerly CJ Healthcare, has expanded significantly since Kolmar Group acquired it in 2018. Its annual revenue has grown from the high 400 billion won range at the time of the acquisition to more than 1 trillion won last year. A key growth driver has been K-CAB, a treatment for gastroesophageal reflux disease and Korea's 30th domestically developed novel drug. Launched in 2019, it recorded cumulative prescription sales of 1.04 trillion won in the first half of this year. HK inno.N has also signed export and licensing agreements covering 55 countries. "Red Bull, the world's No. 1 energy drink brand, has struggled to fully realize its potential in Korea. Its partnership with HK inno.N could provide an opportunity to turn things around," an industry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Kolmar集团获得红牛在韩国的经销权
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Kolmar Group副董事长尹相贤 seeks 通过HK inno.N的分销网络提升该品牌的市场份额。Kolmar Group已取得全球第一大能量饮料品牌Red Bull在韩国的分销权，尹相贤希望将这个奥地利品牌纳入HK inno.N的业务组合，借此把握快速增长的市场。HK inno.N计划利用其全国性分销网络以及打造韩国畅销醒酒饮料Condition的经验，把Condition打造成韩国领先品牌之一，从而扩大Red Bull的市场份额。Red Bull于1987年在奥地利推出，去年全球销量约为140亿罐，同比增长10.2%；营收增长8.6%，创下创纪录的122亿欧元（141亿美元）。全球能量饮料市场也在迅速扩张。 market research firm Grand View Research称，该市场去年估值为853亿美元，预计到2033年将达到1585亿美元，平均年增长率为8.1%。尽管整体饮料消费放缓，韩国能量饮料市场仍保持强劲增长。乐天七星饮料去年能量饮料销售额同比增长11%，达到1072亿韩元；GS25和CU便利店连锁店的能量饮料销售额则分别增长26%和18.3%。能量饮料过去主要由熬夜学习的学生和加班的办公室职员消费，如今正受到更广泛消费者的欢迎，他们希望借助能量饮料为运动和户外活动补充能量。Embrain Trend Monitor称，从去年4月到今年3月，韩国国内能量饮料购买量增长14.7%。40多岁消费者的增幅最强，达到21.7%；其次是20多岁消费者，增长19.1%；50多岁消费者增长14.6%，表明需求正从年轻消费者群体向外扩展。尽管Red Bull在全球占据主导地位，尹相贤认为该品牌在韩国仍有很大的拓展空间。目前，该品牌在国内能量饮料市场排名第三。尹相贤相信，HK inno.N凭借Condition取得的成功所积累的销售专长和全国便利店网络，能够帮助巩固Red Bull的市场地位。据报道，尹相贤亲自参与了争取分销权的最后阶段谈判。这并非尹相贤首次寻求新的增长机会。HK inno.N前身为CJ Healthcare，自Kolmar Group于2018年收购以来实现了显著扩张。其年营收从收购时接近4000亿韩元的高位区间增长至去年超过1万亿韩元。K-CAB是推动增长的重要动力之一，这是一种用于治疗胃食管反流病的药物，也是韩国第30款国产新药。该药于2019年推出，今年上半年累计处方销售额达到1.04万亿韩元。HK inno.N还签署了覆盖55个国家的出口和授权协议。一位行业人士表示：“Red Bull是全球第一大能量饮料品牌，但一直难以在韩国充分发挥潜力。它与HK inno.N的合作可能带来扭转局面的机会。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: What Korea can learn from California's 10-flagship university system
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: UC Berkeley official says cooperation, consensus and shared governance hold key to strengthening regional universities Collaboration, rather than competition, backed by strong leadership and shared governance, has been key to building a University of California (UC) system in which all 10 campuses thrive by developing their own strengths.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校官员表示，合作、共识和共同治理是加强区域大学的关键；以合作为导向而非竞争，并在有力领导和共同治理的支持下，加州大学（UC）得以建设一个让全部10所分校通过发展各自优势而蓬勃发展的体系。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: UC Berkeley official says cooperation, consensus and shared governance hold key to strengthening regional universities Collaboration, rather than competition, backed by strong leadership and shared governance, has been key to building a University of California (UC) system in which all 10 campuses thrive by developing their own strengths. Darren Cooke, chief innovation and entrepreneurship officer at UC Berkeley, emphasized the importance of strong leadership and a shared governing structure in bringing universities together while allowing each to build on its own strengths. "Every one is amazing, right, and has its own strengths, and I think that's the key. Every one has its own strengths," Cooke said during an interview with The Korea Times. The UC system offers lessons for Korea as the government seeks to strengthen regional flagship national universities and develop them into institutions capable of competing with Seoul National University. The UC system brings together 10 campuses, including Berkeley, UCLA and UC San Diego, under a single governing structure while allowing each to develop its own academic and research strengths. "Most systems have one flagship, like one best campus of all of them," Cooke said, noting that UC, by contrast, has 10 flagships. He attributed the system's collaborative approach partly to its unified governance, with the Board of Regents overseeing all 10 campuses and the UC Office of the President coordinating efforts across the network. Cooke acknowledged that establishing a unified governing structure could be challenging, emphasizing that building consensus and a willingness to cooperate among universities would be crucial. "My guess is you'd have to get consensus and get different groups to want to work together rather than have unified governance," he said. He also credited the UC system's leadership with fostering a culture of collaboration, in which campuses view one another as partners rather than competitors. As chair of the UC President's Entrepreneurship Network Council, Cooke is now seeking to expand collaboration across the entire UC system. The council oversees systemwide programs, including funding to help researchers turn their discoveries into commercial opportunities, support for international startup founders and awards recognizing innovation. More recently, Cooke introduced a new initiative, bringing together innovation leaders from all 10 campuses to share successful programs, exchange expertise and identify areas where they can support one another. The initiative has already opened opportunities for cooperation between campuses, including UC Santa Barbara and UC Merced, that might otherwise have gone unexplored. “Unless you convened a group like that, they wouldn’t have the opportunity to even discuss it,” he said. Cooke said the goal is to replicate Berkeley's collaborative approach across the broader UC system, allowing campuses to learn from one another and make better use of their collective strengths. He said stronger university-led startup ecosystems could help regional universities attract talent and investment, but retaining entrepreneurs would also require support from local governments. He pointed to UC Berkeley's efforts to work with city officials to create a more "founder-friendly" environment, including better infrastructure and policies that encourage startups to stay and grow locally. "I think that could be translated to Korea," he said, urging local governments to take a more proactive approach to supporting entrepreneurs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国能从加利福尼亚州拥有10所旗舰高校的体系中汲取什么
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校官员表示，合作、共识和共同治理是加强区域大学的关键。在强大领导力和共同治理的支持下，合作而非竞争一直是建设加州大学（UC）体系的关键；该体系让旗下所有10所分校都能发展各自优势、共同繁荣。加州大学伯克利分校首席创新与创业官达伦·库克强调，在凝聚各所大学的同时，也要让每所大学都能发挥自身优势，强有力的领导力和共同的治理结构至关重要。库克在接受《韩国时报》采访时说：“每一所大学都很出色，对吧？每一所大学都有自身优势，我认为这就是关键。每一所大学都有自身优势。”在韩国政府寻求加强区域旗舰国立大学，并将其打造为能够与首尔大学竞争的机构之际，加州大学体系为韩国提供了借鉴。加州大学体系将伯克利分校、加州大学洛杉矶分校和加州大学圣迭戈分校等10所分校置于统一的治理结构之下，同时允许每所分校发展自身的学术与科研优势。库克说：“大多数体系只有一所旗舰大学，也就是其中最好的一所。”他指出，相比之下，加州大学拥有10所旗舰大学。他认为，该体系采取合作方式，部分原因在于其统一治理：校董会监督全部10所分校，加州大学校长办公室则协调整个大学网络的工作。库克承认，建立统一的治理结构可能颇具挑战，但他强调，形成共识以及各所大学愿意合作将至关重要。他说：“我猜，你必须先形成共识，让不同群体愿意携手合作，而不是靠统一治理来推动。”他还认为，加州大学体系的领导层培育了合作文化，使各所分校将彼此视为伙伴，而非竞争者。作为加州大学校长创业网络委员会主席，库克目前正寻求在加州大学整个体系内扩大合作。该委员会负责监督全系统项目，包括提供资金，帮助研究人员将研究发现转化为商业机会；为国际初创企业创始人提供支持；以及设立表彰创新的奖项。最近，库克推出了一项新倡议，召集全部10所分校的创新负责人分享成功项目、交流专业知识，并找出彼此能够提供支持的领域。这项倡议已经为包括加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校和加州大学默塞德分校在内的分校创造了原本可能不会出现的合作机会。他说：“除非你召集这样一个群体，否则他们甚至连讨论这件事的机会都没有。”库克表示，其目标是在更广泛的加州大学体系中推广伯克利分校的合作模式，让各所分校相互学习，更好地利用集体优势。他说，由大学主导的创业生态如果得到加强，能够帮助区域大学吸引人才和投资，但留住创业者同样需要地方政府提供支持。他提到，加州大学伯克利分校正努力与市政府合作，打造更“对创业者友好”的环境，包括完善基础设施和出台政策，鼓励初创企业留在当地并发展壮大。他说：“我认为，这套做法可以移植到韩国。”他敦促地方政府采取更积极主动的态度，为创业者提供支持

Unlock these with Subscription Indian democracy is "sacred" and the Congress is ready to face electoral defeats until people realise that the system has been completely demolished, Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi said. Interacting with students at the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Gandhi said boycotting elections over alleged flaws in the electoral system would bring an end to Indian democracy, and the Congress party does not intend to do that. "Indian democracy is sacred. For me to even say that there is a problem in Indian democracy is difficult without 100, 200, 300 per cent proof," he said during the interaction moderated by Prof Robert Pape. The Congress leader said asking the opposition to boycott elections would end democracy that very minute. "But what happens to all the opposition workers if we tell them, 'Okay, don't participate in the election?' If we say that we are not going to contest elections, we end Indian democracy that minute. And we don't want to end the structure of Indian democracy,” Mr. Gandhi said. “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,” he said. Mr. Gandhi was on a two-day visit to the U.S. during which he interacted with the students of Columbia University in New York on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.title: Imo Electoral Commission, ADC Disagree Over Council Polls Postponement
https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.summary: Mike Ejiogu, disclosed the postponement while interacting with LEADERSHIP, assuring political parties, the electorate and other stakeholders that a new date, timetable and electoral guidelines would be announced within the shortest possible time.
https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.summary_zh: 迈克·埃乔古在与《LEADERSHIP》交流时披露了推迟消息，并保证将在尽可能短的时间内向各政党、选民及其他利益相关方公布新的日期、时间表和选举指引。
https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.body: ISIEC chairman, Hon. Mike Ejiogu, disclosed the postponement while interacting with LEADERSHIP, assuring political parties, the electorate and other stakeholders that a new date, timetable and electoral guidelines would be announced within the shortest possible time. Ejiogu said the decision followed extensive consultations and engagements with critical stakeholders in the electoral process, and called on all stakeholders to sustain their cooperation and understanding. He explained that the Commission had, on September 18, 2025, issued a 360-day notification for the conduct of the 2026 local government elections in line with Section 7(1) of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, as amended, Imo State Government Law No. 6, Section 16(1), and the Imo State Independent Electoral Commission Establishment Law 2005, as amended. According to him, the Commission had initially scheduled the elections for September 26, 2026, following the expiration of the two-year tenure of the 27 Local Government Council Chairmen and Councillors who were elected on September 21, 2024, and sworn into office on September 30, 2024. He said the earlier date generated concerns among critical stakeholders, particularly the Inter-Party Advisory Council (IPAC), with some members approaching the judiciary to seek an extension of the electoral timeline. In response, ISIEC embarked on constructive engagements with IPAC and other stakeholders, which resulted in the postponement of the September 26 election to November 7, 2026. Ejiogu said the latest stakeholders’ meeting was convened to provide an opportunity for further consultations, explain the circumstances surrounding the electoral process and obtain informed suggestions from political parties towards determining a new election date. He described IPAC as a strategic partner in the electoral process, noting that the Commission could not operate in isolation from political parties and other critical stakeholders. Ejiogu emphasised that ISIEC remained an impartial electoral management body, independent of political party interests, and committed to providing a level playing ground for all registered political parties, their supporters and candidates. According to him, the Commission’s allegiance remained firmly with the Constitution, the ISIEC Establishment Law and the people of Imo State. He reassured political parties and candidates that the Commission would guarantee a transparent and credible electoral environment that would allow all qualified candidates to participate freely. On security, Ejiogu called on political parties, supporters and aspirants to demonstrate political tolerance, shun violence, thuggery, hate speech and other activities capable of undermining democratic stability. He cautioned against the destruction of opponents’ campaign billboards and posters, as well as inflammatory comments capable of causing a breakdown of law and order. He said the security agencies would ensure adequate security before, during and after the elections, and charged political parties to embrace and sign a Peace Accord, stressing that no individual or group would be allowed to undermine the will of the electorate. Ejiogu reminded political parties of the need to uphold internal democracy by conducting credible and transparent primaries, noting that the Electoral Act 2022 requires ISIEC to observe political party primaries. He said the emergence of credible candidates through democratic internal processes would strengthen the legitimacy of the forthcoming elections. He disclosed that the elections would cover 4,758 polling units and 305 wards across the 27 council areas of the state. Ejiogu urged traditional rulers, presidents-general, religious leaders, women and youth organisations to support the Commission through grassroots sensitisation and mobilisation to encourage massive voter participation and reduce voter apathy. He described the traditional institution as an important partner in grassroots democratic development, given its influence and position as custodian of the people’s culture and traditions. Ejiogu reiterated that despite the postponement, ISIEC remained fully committed to discharging its constitutional responsibility of conducting peaceful, transparent and credible local government elections that would produce democratically elected chairmen and councillors across the state. Reacting, the state chairman of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Prof. James Okoroma, said the postponement was a gimmick to delay the party. “Election cannot be postponed indefinitely without a new, gazetted timetable. Shortest possible time is not a date. Candidates have spent money, printed posters, mobilised agents. Indefinite postponement drains opposition parties while the ruling party stays in power through Sole Administrators,” Okoroma said. “If you postpone three times, you are not preparing an election, you are preparing an excuse. Give us a date, give us a timetable, and let Imo people vote. “We demand transparency. ISIEC has not given a specific reason for the 7th of November postponement, beyond consultations and constraints.” We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.title_zh: 伊莫州选举委员会与ADC就推迟州议会选举产生分歧
https://leadership.ng/imo-electoral-comm.body_zh: ISIEC主席Hon. Mike Ejiogu在与LEADERSHIP互动时披露了选举延期消息，并保证将在尽可能短的时间内向各政党、选民及其他利益相关方公布新的日期、时间表和选举指引。Ejiogu表示，此项决定是在与选举进程中的关键利益相关方进行了广泛磋商和沟通后作出的，并呼吁所有利益相关方继续予以合作和理解。他解释道，委员会已于2025年9月18日根据经修订的《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法》第7(1)条、经修订的《伊莫州政府法》第6号第16(1)条以及经修订的《2005年伊莫州独立选举委员会设立法》，就举行2026年地方政府选举发布了360天通知。据他介绍，委员会最初将选举安排在2026年9月26日，因为于2024年9月21日当选并于2024年9月30日宣誓就任的27个地方议会主席和议员两年任期届满。他说，原定日期引发了关键利益相关方的担忧，尤其是党际咨询委员会（IPAC），部分成员甚至前往司法机关寻求延长选举时间表。为此，ISIEC与IPAC及其他利益相关方展开了建设性沟通，最终将9月26日的选举推迟至2026年11月7日。Ejiogu表示，召开最近一次利益相关方会议，旨在为进一步磋商提供机会，说明选举进程的相关情况，并从各政党获取充分建议，以确定新的选举日期。他将IPAC称为选举进程中的战略伙伴，并指出委员会不能在脱离政党及其他关键利益相关方的情况下运作。Ejiogu强调，ISIEC仍是独立于政党利益之外的公正选举管理机构，并致力于为所有注册政党、其支持者和候选人提供公平竞争的平台。据他表示，委员会始终坚定不移地效忠于《宪法》、ISIEC设立法以及伊莫州人民。他向各政党和候选人保证，委员会将确保营造透明、可信的选举环境，使所有符合条件的候选人都能自由参选。在安全方面，Ejiogu呼吁各政党、支持者和有志参政人士展现政治宽容，拒绝暴力、勾结寻衅、仇恨言论及其他可能破坏民主稳定的活动。他警告不要破坏竞争对手竞选期间的广告牌和海报，也不要发表可能引发法律与秩序崩溃的煽动性言论。他说，安全机构将在选举前、选举期间和选举后确保提供充分安保，并要求各政党接受并签署《和平协定》，强调不会允许任何个人或团体破坏选民的意志。Ejiogu提醒各政党，需要通过举行可信且透明的初选来维护内部民主，并指出《2022年选举法》要求ISIEC观察政党初选。他说，通过民主内部程序推出可信的候选人，将增强即将举行的选举的合法性。他透露，本次选举将覆盖该州27个议会区的4,758个投票点和305个选区单位。Ejiogu敦促传统领袖、社团主席、宗教领袖、妇女组织和青年组织通过基层宣传与动员支持委员会，鼓励选民广泛参与投票，减少选民冷漠现象。鉴于传统机构具有影响力，并承担着守护人民文化和传统的职责，他称传统机构是基层民主发展的重要伙伴。Ejiogu重申，尽管选举延期，ISIEC仍完全致力于履行其宪法职责，举行和平、透明且可信的地方政府选举，从而在全州选出经民主选举产生的地方议会主席和议员。对此，非洲民主大会（ADC）州主席James Okoroma教授表示，推迟选举是企图延迟该党的策略。Okoroma说：“在没有新的、经过官方公报公布的时间表的情况下，选举不能无限期推迟。‘尽可能短的时间’并不是一个具体日期。候选人们已经花钱印制海报、动员监票代理人员。无限期拖延会消耗反对党的力量，而执政党则可以通过‘临时管理者’继续执政。如果你推迟三次，那么你不是为选举做准备，而是在为找借口做准备。给我们一个日期，给我们一份时间表，让伊莫州人民投票吧。‘我们要求透明。ISIEC没有说明推迟至11月7日的具体原因，只说是磋商和制约因素。’我们将掌握先机。获取实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111916.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 김윤구 기자 = 정의경 국토교통부 제2차관은 19일 철도교통 파업을 앞두고 노사 간 원만한 합의를 촉구하고 대체교통수단 확보 등 철저한 대비를 당부했다. 정 차관은 이날 한국철도공사(코레일), 서울교통공사, GTX-A 등 철도 운영기관의 파업에 대비한 비상수송대책 점검회의를 주재했다. 정 차관은 각 기관의 노사 교섭 현황과 비상열차 운영계획, 비상수송 대책 등을 보고받고 수도권 전철과 KTX 운행률을 점검했다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111916.title_zh: 韩国国土交通部为应对铁路罢工检查应急运输措施，称将“充分做好应对”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111916.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者 Kim Yun-gu 报道称，国土交通部第二次官郑义敬于19日在铁路交通罢工前夕，敦促劳资双方达成顺利协议，并要求做好充分准备，包括确保替代交通手段。郑次官当天主持召开紧急运输对策检查会议，检查韩国铁道公社（Korail）、首尔交通公社、GTX-A等铁路运营机构为应对罢工而制定的措施。各机构汇报了劳资协商进展、紧急列车运营计划和紧急运输对策等情况，并检查了首都圈地铁和KTX的运营率。郑次官敦促各铁路运营机构：“请积极与工会沟通，为避免给国民带来不便，尽一切努力促成圆满解决。”他还强调：“为将给国民造成的不便和混乱降至最低，请动员一切可用资源，开行紧急列车，并确保公交、航空等替代交通手段。”国土部将与各铁路运营机构共同运营紧急对策本部，跟踪劳资协商动向；罢工一旦开始，将24小时运行政府联合运输对策本部。报道请通过KakaoTalk的 okjebo 发送。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、复制及用于AI学习和利用。2026/11/19 19:02发布。2026年11月19日19时02分发布。（首尔＝韩联社）国土交通部第二次官郑义敬当天在政府世宗办公大楼国家交通信息中心举行的铁路交通罢工应对紧急运输对策检查会议上主持会议。2026.11.19［国土交通部提供，禁止转售及用于数据库］photo@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111916.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者郑会仁报道：正推进在科斯达克市场上市的第五代移动通信（5G）专用网络专业企业Ucast，在面向普通投资者的公开发行认购中未能达到认购数量。国内企业公开发行普通认购未达目标，自2023年1月在科斯达克市场上市的TMC以来已是约3年10个月以来的首次。据金融投资业界19日报道，Ucast于18日起举行为期两天的普通认购，最终认购竞争率约为0.5比1。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary_zh: 马金德-达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定暂停联邦层面的招聘，并称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境，尤其是求职青年的处境毫不在意。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs. The organisation said the decision contradicted the All Progressives Congress (APC)’s promises on job creation and raised concerns about the government’s commitment to addressing unemployment. In a press statement dated November 17, 2026, and signed by its Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Nnanna Ihediwa, the campaign organisation described the recruitment freeze as an indication of what it called the shortcomings of the Tinubu administration’s economic policies. It also expressed concern that the embargo could precede possible mass retrenchment in the public service under the guise of fiscal discipline, particularly if Tinubu secured re-election in 2027. The organisation cited World Bank estimates that approximately 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, arguing that restricting federal recruitment would further limit employment opportunities for young people. The MDPCO also rejected the Presidency’s explanation that the embargo was intended to consolidate public service reforms and enable the government to properly determine personnel requirements for the 2027 budget. It argued that the government should instead focus on expanding the economy, harnessing the country’s human and natural resources, and creating employment opportunities. The campaign organisation further faulted comments attributed to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, describing Nigerians complaining about hunger and hardship as lazy. According to the statement, the 2027 general election would provide Nigerians an opportunity to assess the economic direction of the country and decide on the leadership they want. It contrasted the Federal Government’s recruitment policy with what it described as employment-generating initiatives under Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde. The organisation said Makinde’s administration had expanded economic opportunities in Oyo State through public and private sector initiatives, particularly in agriculture, infrastructure, education, transportation and other critical sectors. It specifically highlighted the establishment of the Oyo State Agribusiness Development Agency (OYSADA), which it said had transformed traditional farm settlements into modern agro-industrial hubs. Other initiatives cited included investments in power generation, aviation, road infrastructure, water resources, revenue reforms and improvements in the public workforce. The campaign organisation said Makinde’s proposed RESET Nigeria Agenda was anchored on expanding economic opportunities, reducing waste without weakening public institutions, maintaining fiscal discipline without restricting employment, and pursuing economic stability without undermining citizens’ livelihoods. It said the agenda offered an alternative economic direction ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The organisation urged Nigerians to consider Makinde, who is the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election, arguing that his administration’s development approach in Oyo State could be replicated at the national level. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队就联邦招聘禁令指责蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body_zh:
第一层 马金德－达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定禁止联邦政府机构招聘，称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境缺乏体谅，尤其是对正在寻找工作的年轻人。该组织表示，这项决定与进步大会党（APC）关于创造就业岗位的承诺相悖，并引发人们对政府解决失业问题承诺的担忧。

在一份日期为2026年11月17日、由其战略传播主任理查德·恩南纳·伊赫迪瓦签署的新闻声明中，该竞选组织称冻结招聘凸显了其所称的蒂努布政府经济政策的缺陷。它还担忧，这项禁令可能先于公共部门可能发生的大规模裁员，而裁员将以财政纪律为名，尤其是在蒂努布于2027年成功连任的情况下。该组织援引世界银行的估算称，每年约有350万名尼日利亚人进入劳动力市场，并认为限制联邦招聘将进一步减少年轻人的就业机会。

MDPCO还驳斥了总统府关于实施招聘禁令旨在巩固公共服务改革、使政府能够妥善确定2027年预算人员需求的解释。它认为，政府转而应当专注于扩大经济，开发国家的人力和自然资源，并创造就业机会。

该竞选组织还批评了据称出自APC总统竞选委员会主任、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里参议员的言论，称他把抱怨饥饿和困苦的尼日利亚人描述为懒惰。

声明表示，2027年大选将为尼日利亚人提供一次机会，以评估国家经济的发展方向，并决定他们希望由谁领导。该组织将联邦政府的招聘政策与其所称的奥约州州长塞伊·马金德推行的就业创造举措进行了对比。该组织说，马金德政府通过公共和私营部门的举措扩大了奥约州的经济机会，尤其是在农业、基础设施、教育、交通运输及其他关键领域。

该组织特别提到成立奥约州农业综合发展局（OYSADA），并称该机构已把传统农庄转变为现代农工业中心。列举的其他举措包括对发电、航空、道路基础设施、水资源、税收改革和公共 workforce 改善的投资。

该竞选组织表示，马金德提出的“重置尼日利亚议程”以扩大经济机会、在不削弱公共机构的情况下减少浪费、在不限制就业的情况下维持财政纪律，以及在不损害公民生计的情况下追求经济稳定为基础。它称，在2027年总统选举前夕，该议程提供了一条替代性的经济发展道路。

该组织敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选中考虑马金德。他是联盟人民运动（APM）的总统候选人。该组织认为，他在奥约州采用的发展方式可以在全国范围内复制。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.summary_zh: 中国实施零关税政策后，加纳对华出口大幅增长，2026年6月自加纳进口额达到2.9亿美元。中国驻加纳大使丛苏宗在阿克拉举行的2026年奖学金校友协会招待会暨中加零关税论坛上宣布了这一消息。该论坛由加纳商务部奖学金校友协会（MOSAAG）主办，是中国面向非洲国家零关税让步全国能力建设计划的一部分。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.body: Ghana’s exports to China rose sharply following the implementation of China’s zero-tariff policy, with imports from Ghana reaching US$290 million in June 2026. The initiative is expected to expand market access for Ghanaian products and create opportunities for local exporters seeking to enter the Chinese market. Mr Cong Song, Chinese Ambassador to Ghana, announced this at the 2026 Scholarship Alumni Association Reception and China-Ghana Zero-Tariff Forum in Accra. He said bilateral trade between Ghana and China reached $14.12 billion in 2025, while Ghana’s exports to China amounted to $2.67 billion, representing a 33.9 per cent increase over previous years. The forum, organised by the MOFCOM Scholars Alumni Association of Ghana (MOSAAG), formed part of a nationwide capacity-building initiative on China’s zero-tariff concession for African countries. Mr Cong said the policy would reduce the cost of African products entering the Chinese market and improve their competitiveness. He said China’s removal of tariffs on African goods would strengthen confidence in Africa’s economic prospects, support international trade and attract new investment. “The zero-tariff policy is offered unilaterally, with no requirement for African countries to open their markets reciprocally. There is no ceiling on the volume of African exports to China. “It comes with no political strings attached…For African countries, this means the door of opportunity to China’s mega-market of 1.4 billion people is wide open,” he said. The Ambassador highlighted ongoing cooperation between Ghana and China across the mining value chain, including geological exploration, local processing, value addition and skills development. He urged Chinese businesses operating in Ghana to comply with local laws and regulations and called for a conducive environment for investment. Mr Cong encouraged MOSAAG to deepen public awareness of the zero-tariff initiative, identify export opportunities and help address implementation challenges. “Let us join hands to harness the momentum of China’s zero-tariff treatment, and use the certainty of high-level bilateral opening-up and cooperation to offset the uncertainties in the global environment, injecting sustained and strong momentum into Africa’s development,” he said. In a speech read on his behalf, Mr Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Minister for Foreign Affairs, said the government remained committed to partnerships that supported industrialisation and economic transformation. “Our interest is not to only to attract investment into the country; we seek partnerships that establish local production facilities, develop domestic supply chains, strengthen the skills of our workforce and create decent and sustainable jobs,” he said. The Minister urged Ghanaian exporters to meet Chinese market requirements to fully benefit from the policy and deepen trade relations between the two countries. He said the government would continue efforts to strengthen domestic production, improve competitiveness and create a business environment conducive to enterprise growth. Mr Leonard Edem Cosmos, President of MOSAAG, said the forum sought to equip producers, agro-processors and small and medium-sized enterprises with the knowledge required to access the Chinese market. “Knowing that duties have been removed is only the first step; knowing how to navigate sanitary and phytosanitary standards, packaging regulations, rules of origin, logistics, and Chinese buyer expectations is where real trade happens,” he said. Mr Cosmos said the association would support capacity-building efforts, connect Ghanaian businesses with credible Chinese partners and promote effective implementation of the zero-tariff policy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.title_zh: 零关税政策推动加纳对华出口激增
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.body_zh: 中国实施零关税政策后，加纳对华出口大幅增长，2026年6月从加纳进口的产品价值达到2.9亿美元。外界预计，这项举措将扩大加纳产品进入市场的渠道，为寻求进入中国市场的本地出口商创造机会。中国驻加纳大使丛松在阿克拉举行的2026年奖学金校友协会招待会暨中加零关税论坛上宣布了上述消息。他说，2025年加纳与中国的双边贸易额达到141.2亿美元，其中加纳对华出口额为26.7亿美元，较以往增长33.9%。该论坛由加纳商务部奖学金校友协会（MOSAAG）组织，是围绕中国对非洲国家零关税让步在全国开展能力建设计划的一部分。丛松说，这项政策将降低非洲产品进入中国市场的成本，提高其竞争力。他说，中国取消对非洲商品征收关税，将增强各方对非洲经济前景的信心，支持国际贸易并吸引新的投资。他说：“零关税政策是单方面提供的，不要求非洲国家对等开放市场。非洲商品对华出口量没有上限。‘这项政策不附带任何政治条件……对非洲国家而言，这意味着通往拥有14亿人口的中国超大市场的大门已经敞开。’大使强调，加纳与中国正在矿业价值链各环节持续开展合作，包括地质勘探、本地加工、增值加工和技能开发。他敦促在加纳经营的中国企业遵守当地法律法规，并呼吁营造有利于投资的环境。丛松鼓励MOSAAG加强零关税举措的公众宣传，发现出口机会，并协助解决政策实施中的各项挑战。他说：“让我们携手合作，利用中国零关税待遇带来的势头，以高层双边开放与合作带来的确定性抵消全球环境中的不确定性，为非洲发展注入持续而强劲的动力。”在一篇代其宣读的讲话中，外交部长Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa表示，政府仍致力于支持工业化和经济转型的伙伴关系。他说：“我们的目标不仅是吸引投资流入国内；我们还寻求建立本地生产设施、发展国内供应链、提升劳动力技能并创造体面且可持续就业的合作伙伴关系。”部长敦促加纳出口商满足中国市场要求，充分利用该政策，并深化两国贸易关系。他说，政府将继续努力加强国内生产、提高竞争力，并营造有利于企业发展的商业环境。MOSAAG主席Leonard Edem Cosmos说，该论坛旨在为生产商、农产品加工商以及中小企业配备进入中国市场所需的知识。他说：“知道关税已经取消只是第一步；懂得如何应对卫生与植物卫生标准、包装规定、原产地规则、物流要求以及中国采购商的期望，才是真正开展贸易的关键。”Cosmos说，协会将支持能力建设努力，为加纳企业对接信誉良好的中国合作伙伴，并推动零关税政策有效落实

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — A breakthrough in negotiations on services and investment under the Korea-China free trade agreement (FTA) lays the institutional groundwork for deeper economic cooperation between the two countries, presidential chief of staff for policy Ha Joon-kyung said. The two countries announced they had reached a substantive agreement during a summit between President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Wednesday, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. The breakthrough came eight years and eight months after negotiations began. Speaking at a briefing, Ha said China accounts for a smaller share of Korea’s trade in services than of its trade in goods, leaving considerable room for growth. As economic ties deepen, he said, companies begin investing in each other’s markets and providing services such as legal advice and cultural content under local laws and regulations. Under the agreement, the two countries will improve access to each other’s markets in sectors including cultural content, tourism and legal services. “Accordingly, the deal lays the institutional groundwork for a significant step forward in economic cooperation between the two countries,” Ha said. The two countries also agreed to strengthen investment protections and make regulations more transparent. The deal introduces a most-favored-nation obligation, requiring each country to treat companies from the other at least as favorably as it treats companies from third countries. Ha also credited the Lee administration’s efforts to restore bilateral ties, saying reciprocal state visits helped improve relations and led Beijing to take a more flexible stance in the negotiations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国—中国自由贸易协定就服务和投资达成协议，为深化经济关系奠定基础：青瓦台
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 中国深圳——韩国总统政策总协调秘书河埈璟表示，韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务和投资谈判取得突破，为两国深化经济合作奠定了制度基础。周三，在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间，韩国总统李在明与中国国家主席习近平举行峰会，两国宣布已达成实质性协议。此次突破是在谈判启动8年零8个月后取得的。河埈璟在新闻发布会上表示，中国在韩国服务贸易中所占比重低于在货物贸易中所占比重，服务贸易仍有相当大的增长空间。随着经济联系不断加深，两国企业开始相互投资市场，并依据当地法律法规提供法律咨询、文化内容等服务。根据该协议，两国将改善文化内容、旅游和法律服务等领域的市场准入。河埈璟说：“因此，该协议为两国经济合作迈出重要一步奠定了制度基础。”两国还同意加强投资保护，并提高法规的透明度。该协议引入最惠国待遇义务，要求各国对另一国企业的待遇不得低于对第三国企业的待遇。河埈璟还肯定了李在明政府为恢复双边关系所作的努力，称两国领导人互访推动双边关系改善，并促使北京在谈判中采取更加灵活的立场

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 七十多年后，朝鲜战争老兵姜九宪仍记得一名年轻美国士兵为生存而战时说出的那五个字。这名士兵年仅19岁，抵达朝鲜不到一周便腹部遭受重伤。然而，整场采访中，姜九宪始终反复讲述着这名受伤美国士兵的故事。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: More than seven decades later, Korean War veteran Kang Ku-kon still remembers those five words spoken by a young American soldier fighting for his life. The soldier, barely 19, had suffered a severe abdominal wound less than a week after arriving in Korea. Kang, who was helping at a U.S. Army field hospital, was just 15 himself when he went to serve in the 1950-53 Korean War. During a visit to the U.S. Eighth Army headquarters at Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province on Nov. 5, Kang recalled his years with American soldiers. Kang spent part of his childhood in Japan, where his father ran a construction business. He learned to ride horses at an early age but also witnessed American bombing raids during World War II. By the time war broke out in his own country, he already knew how devastating it could be. In 1950, Kang fled his rural hometown in Yeongdong, North Chungcheong Province, for the southeastern city of Daegu by train. There, he saw dozens of wounded soldiers being brought to an army hospital every day. Shocked by what he saw, Kang volunteered for military service with his friends. “My parents would have stopped me if I’d told them. So I went without telling them,” he said. After a few days of military training in Busan, Kang went into battle. The little English he had learned at school helped him join an American unit. He later assisted military doctors at an Eighth Army field hospital, fetching bandages and other medical supplies. “I could usually tell what they needed. They’d be pleased when I brought them the right things. They often told me I was smart,” he said. Kang also remembers an American sergeant who looked out for him. A World War II veteran, the sergeant kept fighting even after being shot in the shoulder. “Even as a boy, I felt grateful to those Americans and sorry for them. They had come to help our little country and were making such sacrifices,” he said. The trip to Camp Humphreys was Kang’s first visit to a U.S. military base since completing his military service. Today, he hands out booklets about the war whenever he meets students, telling them about his own experiences. But throughout the interview, Kang kept returning to the story of the wounded American soldier. He had reassured the young man that he would survive and see his mother again. Kang wishes they had had enough time to exchange addresses. Perhaps then he could have found out what happened to him. But at the time, bullets were flying past his ears. “I don’t think he survived,” Kang said. “I still think about him.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: “我能见见我的母亲吗？”一名朝鲜战争老兵回忆一名美国士兵的恳求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 朝鲜战争结束七十多年后，朝鲜战争老兵姜九官仍记得那名拼死搏斗的年轻美国士兵说过的五个字。那名士兵年仅19岁，抵达朝鲜不到一周便腹部遭受重伤。姜九官当时在美国陆军野战医院协助工作；1950年至1953年朝鲜战争期间，他也才15岁，便投入了服役。11月5日，姜九官参观位于京畿道平泽的汉弗莱营美国第八集团军总部，回忆了自己与美国士兵共度的岁月。姜九官童年时曾有一段时间住在日本，父亲在那里经营建筑业务。他很小就学会了骑马，但也亲眼目睹了第二次世界大战期间美国的轰炸行动。战争在他的祖国爆发时，他已经知道战争会带来多么惨重的后果。1950年，姜九官乘火车逃离位于忠清北道永同的乡村家乡，前往东南部城市大邱。在那里，他每天都看到数十名伤兵被送进军医院。眼前的景象令他震惊，于是他和朋友们主动报名参军。他说：“如果我告诉父母，他们一定会阻止我。所以我没告诉他们就去了。”在釜山经过数日军事训练后，姜九官便奔赴战场。他在学校学过的那点英语，帮助他加入了一支美国部队。后来，他在第八集团军野战医院协助军医，取送绷带和其他医疗物资。他说：“我通常能看出他们需要什么。我把东西送到时，他们会很高兴。他们常常说我很聪明。”姜九官还记得一名照顾过他的美国中士。那名中士是第二次世界大战老兵，肩膀中弹后仍继续战斗。他说：“即使我还是个孩子，也为那些美国人感到感激，同时对他们感到抱歉。他们前来帮助我们这个小国，却付出了如此巨大的牺牲。”完成兵役后，这是姜九官首次参观美国军事基地。如今，每当遇到学生，他都会向他们分发有关这场战争的小册子，讲述自己的经历。然而整个采访过程中，姜九官始终回到那名受伤美国士兵的故事。姜九官曾安慰那名年轻人，说他会活下来，还会再次见到母亲。姜九官希望他们当时有足够时间交换地址，或许那样他就能知道那名士兵后来怎么样了。但当时，子弹正从他耳边飞过。他说：“我认为他没有活下来。我至今仍会想起他。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — South Korea is closely watching how matters affecting the Korean Peninsula may be handled at the U.S.-China-Russia summit, Thursday, according to a Cheong Wa Dae offiical. “Since we won’t be at the table, we are naturally interested in how issues that concern us will be addressed,” he said. “We believe we need to take appropriate steps on our end, and we are doing so.” On Thursdsay, the three-way meeting will take place among U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China. Asked about speculation that the meeting could become a “second Yalta,” the official said many observers doubted it would play out that way, pointing to differences in how the three countries view the 1945 conference. “China, which is hosting the meeting, may itself see the decisions made at Yalta as having come at its expense,” he said, adding that Beijing’s perspective differs from those of Washington and Moscow. At Yalta, the leaders of the U.S. the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union met to discuss the final stages of World War II and the postwar order

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary: Korea will be granted most-favored-nation status in trade with China in the cultural sector, improving market access for Korean films, games and other cultural content. Beijing also agreed to apply nondiscrimination principles to preliminary reviews of online games, films and other content.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 在文化产业贸易中，韩国将获得中国给予的最惠国待遇，从而改善韩国电影、游戏及其他文化内容进入中国市场的机会。北京还同意在网络游戏、电影及其他内容的初步审查中适用非歧视原则。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Korea will be granted most-favored-nation status in trade with China in the cultural sector, improving market access for Korean films, games and other cultural content. On the sidelines of President Lee Jae Myung’s summit with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, Wednesday, the two countries announced the substantial conclusion of follow-up negotiations on services and investment under their bilateral free trade agreement (FTA). The Korea-China FTA took effect in December 2015, but subsequent negotiations on services and investment had remained unresolved despite 17 rounds of talks since March 2018. The negotiations gained momentum after the two leaders agreed during their summit in January to pursue meaningful progress in the follow-up talks within the year. Under the agreement, China pledged to grant most-favored-nation treatment in sectors including films and games, ensuring that Korean content providers receive treatment no less favorable than those from third countries. Beijing also agreed to apply nondiscrimination principles to preliminary reviews of online games, films and other content. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said this is the first time China has included such provisions in a trade agreement, raising expectations that Korean content producers will gain more stable access to the Chinese market. The two countries also agreed to an annex on co-producing audiovisual content, extending the domestic production status previously granted only to government-approved co-produced films to dramas, documentaries, animation and other audiovisual programs. China maintains quotas on imported films and television programs, including restrictions on the number of foreign films and the airtime allocated to overseas content. With the latest agreement, not only co-produced films but also jointly produced dramas, documentaries, animation and other audiovisual programs will be treated as domestic productions in both countries, allowing them to benefit from domestic content quotas rather than being subject to restrictions on foreign content. “The agreement will allow jointly produced content to qualify as domestic productions in both Korea and China,” an industry ministry official said. “This is expected to be one of the most practical benefits of the expanded co-production framework.” In the tourism sector, China agreed to allow Korean travel agencies operating in 23 designated regions of the country to offer outbound travel services to Chinese nationals and foreign residents living in China. The provision will enable Korean travel agencies to directly recruit Chinese group tourists and sell individual travel packages without relying on local intermediaries. The industry ministry said the agreement is expected to create new business opportunities for Korean travel agencies by allowing them to develop and sell travel packages featuring K-pop, beauty, food and regional attractions in Korea. In the legal sector, China agreed to expand the areas where Korean law firms can establish offices and collaborate with Chinese counterparts from the Shanghai Free Trade Zone (FTZ) to include the Tianjin and Qianhai FTZs. In the retail sector, Korean companies will be allowed to independently operate 30 or more stores in China without forming joint ventures with local partners, while restrictions on the types of construction projects Korean firms can undertake will be lifted. On investment protection, the two countries agreed to prohibit forced technology transfers as a condition of investment, and introduce rules preventing the reinstatement of regulations that have already been eased
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 首尔与北京同意让韩国内容更自由地进入中国市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh:
韩国将在文化领域获得中国给予的最惠国贸易待遇，从而改善韩国电影、游戏及其他文化内容进入中国市场的机会。周三，在中国深圳举行的李在明总统与中国国家主席习近平峰会的场边活动上，两国宣布，双方已基本完成《韩中自由贸易协定》框架下服务和投资后续谈判。

《韩中自由贸易协定》于2015年12月生效，但自2018年3月以来举行的17轮会谈均未能解决服务和投资领域的后续谈判问题。今年1月，两国领导人在峰会上同意推动年内后续谈判取得实质性进展，谈判由此加快。根据协议，中国承诺在电影和游戏等领域给予韩国最惠国待遇，确保韩国内容提供商获得的条件不逊于第三国内容提供商。北京还同意对网络游戏、电影及其他内容的预审适用非歧视原则。韩国产业通商资源部表示，这是中国首次在贸易协定中加入此类条款，预计韩国内容制作企业将获得更稳定的中国市场准入。

两国还同意就视听内容联合制作签署附件，将此前仅适用于政府批准的联合制作电影的境内制作资格扩大到电视剧、纪录片、动画片及其他视听节目。中国对进口电影和电视节目实行配额限制，包括限制外国电影数量以及分配给境外内容的播出时段。根据最新协议，不仅联合制作的电影，双方联合制作的电视剧、纪录片、动画片及其他视听节目将在两国均被视为境内制作作品，从而可以享受境内内容配额，而不受外国内容限制。韩国产业通商资源部官员表示：“该协议将使联合制作内容在韩国和中国均具备境内制作资格。这预计将成为扩大联合制作框架带来的最切实成果之一。”

在旅游领域，中国同意允许在中国23个指定地区运营的韩国旅行社向中国公民和居住在中国的外国居民提供出境旅游服务。该条款将允许韩国旅行社直接招揽中国团体游客，并销售个人旅游套餐，而无需依赖当地中介机构。韩国产业通商资源部表示，通过允许韩国旅行社开发和销售以韩国流行音乐、美妆、美食及地方景点为主题的旅游套餐，该协议预计将为韩国旅行社创造新的商业机会。

在法律服务领域，中国同意扩大韩国律师事务所设立办公室并与中国同行开展合作的范围，在上海自由贸易区之外，将天津自由贸易区和前海自由贸易区纳入其中。

在零售领域，韩国企业将获准在中国独立运营30家或更多门店，无需与当地合作伙伴成立合资企业，同时，针对韩国企业可承接的建设项目类型的限制也将取消。

在投资保护方面，两国同意禁止将强制技术转让作为投资条件，并引入相关规则，防止重新实施已经放宽的规定

In his opening remarks during his bilateral meeting with Trump on Wednesday, November 18, Marcos acknowledged the US leader’s tight schedule in the Philippines. Trump arrived late Tuesday afternoon, November 17, and headed straight to the Philippine International Convention Center to attend the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue meeting , the ASEAN-US Special Summit , and other meetings after the conclusion of the 49th ASEAN Summit. “Your schedule has been packed to the hilt, which is not exactly a surprise because we know how hard you work,” Marcos told Trump. Diplomacy via Jollibee is nothing new. In July, Marcos and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney paid a visit to a Jollibee store in Vancouver following their bilateral meeting. Unlock these with Subscription The initiative, announced on the second day of the 29th edition of Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre, is expected to connect innovators directly with State departments to solve public sector challenges. The State government on Wednesday awarded direct work orders to eight start-ups under its “Government First Initiative” to build technology solutions for the Praja Seva Department and the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB). The initiative, announced on the second day of the 29th edition of Bengaluru Tech Summit (BTS) 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC), is expected to connect innovators directly with State departments to solve public sector challenges. Under the programme, each winning start-up is eligible for a direct work order of up to ₹25 lakh. The total committed project value stands at ₹99.78 lakh (inclusive of GST) for the Praja Seva Department, while it is ₹1 crore for the BWSSB. According to the government, the winners emerged from a competitive pool of 150 applications submitted between October 8 and October 23, 2026, with the Praja Seva receiving 76 entries and the BWSSB receiving 74. The rigorous five-stage selection process included application submission, eligibility screening, selection committee evaluation, discussions with respective department officials, and final budget negotiations. The committee assessed start-ups on innovation, technical soundness, product readiness, scalability, and integration capability. Four start-ups were selected to modernise citizen services and administrative workflows for the Praja Seva Department and each was awarded ₹25 lakh. These include: SanMejora, to develop an AI-enabled grievance management and redressal system; VTT AI Private Limited, to create an AI-powered unified citizen call centre; Datafrontier Innovations Private Limited, to build an AI-enabled e-Office and unified officer workflow platform and Nife Apps Labs, to ensure the uptime and availability of citizen-facing government IT services. Responding to media queries, the Minister said other government departments might also come up with respective problem statements, allowing a large number of start-ups to develop solutions and work with the government. The Government First Initiative is a pioneering policy by the State government that makes the State the first customer for local start-ups developing technology-driven solutions to public sector and governance challenges. 这项倡议于2026年班加罗尔科技峰会第29届会议第二天在班加罗尔国际展览中心宣布，预计将让创新者与邦政府各部门直接对接，以解决公共部门面临的挑战。

邦政府于周三向8家初创企业直接授予工作订单，作为“Government First Initiative”的一部分，由这些企业为Praja Seva Department和Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board（BWSSB）开发技术解决方案。

这项倡议于2026年班加罗尔科技峰会（BTS）第29届会议第二天在班加罗尔国际展览中心（BIEC）宣布，预计将让创新者与邦政府各部门直接对接，以解决公共部门面临的挑战。根据该计划，每家获奖初创企业均可获得金额最高达₹25 lakh的直接工作订单。Praja Seva Department已承诺的项目总值约为₹99.78 lakh（含GST），BWSSB已承诺的项目总值为₹1 crore。

据政府介绍，获奖企业是从2026年10月8日至10月23日提交的150份申请中经竞争性筛选产生的，其中Praja Seva收到76份申请，BWSSB收到74份申请。严格开展的五阶段遴选流程包括提交申请、资格审查、遴选委员会评估、与相关部门官员讨论，以及最终预算谈判。委员会从创新性、技术可靠性、产品成熟度、可扩展性和系统集成能力等方面评估初创企业。

共有4家初创企业入选，负责为Praja Seva Department实现公民服务和行政工作流程现代化，每家企业均获得₹25 lakh。这些企业包括：SanMejora，负责开发一套由人工智能支持的申诉管理和处理系统；VTT AI Private Limited，负责打造由人工智能驱动的统一市民呼叫中心；Datafrontier Innovations Private Limited，负责构建由人工智能支持的电子办公和统一官员工作流程平台；Nife Apps Labs，负责确保面向公民的政府信息技术服务保持正常运行并可用。

部长在回应媒体询问时表示，其他政府部门也可能提出各自的难题，让大量初创企业开发解决方案并与政府合作。

Government First Initiative是邦政府推出的一项开创性政策，使邦政府成为本地初创企业的首位客户，支持它们开发以技术驱动的方案，应对公共部门和治理领域的挑战。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The government has sent a team to Myanmar to inspect the site of a Korean Air Lines (KAL) passenger jet crash in 1987 following a North Korean bombing, officials said Wednesday. The team, comprising officials from the foreign ministry and the Korea Coast Guard, as well as divers and vessel operators, left for Myanmar last week and is conducting an on-site inspection of waters believed to contain the wreckage of KAL Flight 858, according to government officials. Based on the findings, the government plans to assess the feasibility of recovering the wreckage and victims' remains, they added. It marks the first time the South Korean government has conducted an on-site investigation of the suspected crash site, despite previous private-sector efforts to access or investigate the area. The flight, en route from Baghdad to Seoul, exploded over waters near Myanmar on Nov. 29, 1987, killing all 115 passengers and crew members aboard. None of the 115 victims' remains have been recovered. South Korea's then state security agency concluded that two North Korean agents, including Kim Hyon-hui, carried out the bombing. A subsequent reinvestigation under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, completed in October 2007, upheld the conclusion, while the victims' families have continued to call for a full investigation, citing the lack of physical evidence beyond Kim's testimony. The mission follows years of consultations between South Korea and Myanmar, which began around 2019. Plans for the inspection were delayed amid political instability in Myanmar, including the 2021 military coup, the officials said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 官员周三表示，政府已派遣一个小组赴缅甸，调查1987年大韩航空（KAL）客机在朝鲜爆炸后坠毁的现场。该小组由外交部、韩国海岸警卫队以及潜水员和船舶作业人员组成，于上周前往缅甸，正在对据信沉有KAL 858号班机残骸的水域进行现场检查。政府官员称，政府将根据调查结果评估打捞残骸和遇难者遗骸的可行性。尽管此前私营部门曾尝试进入或调查该地区，这是韩国政府首次对疑似坠机现场进行实地调查。该航班于1987年11月29日从巴格达飞往首尔途中，在缅甸附近水域上空爆炸，机上115名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。遇难者遗骸至今无一被寻回。韩国时任国家安全机构认定，包括金贤惠在内的两名朝鲜特工实施了此次爆炸。鲁穆玄政府后来重新开展调查，并于2007年10月完成调查，维持了这一结论；遇难者家属则持续要求进行全面调查，理由是除了金的证词外缺乏其他物证。官员表示，此次行动是韩国与缅甸经过多年磋商后展开的，相关磋商始于2019年左右。由于缅甸政治局势不稳定，包括2021年军事政变在内，检查计划曾被推迟。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Top military officers of Korea and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on Wednesday discussed efforts to facilitate combined operations across all domains, with a focus on smooth intelligence sharing, the allies' Combined Forces Command (CFC) said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国和驻韩美军（USFK）的最高军事将领周三讨论了推动各领域联合行动的努力，重点是确保情报顺畅共享。盟军联合司令部（CFC）表示。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Top military officers of Korea and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on Wednesday discussed efforts to facilitate combined operations across all domains, with a focus on smooth intelligence sharing, the allies' Combined Forces Command (CFC) said. The South's Joint Chief of Staff Chairman Gen. Jin Yong-sung co-led the meeting with USFK Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson, who doubles as the CFC commander, for discussions on how the combined forces can work together to advance the strategy, known as combined joint all-domain operations (CJADO), the CFC said in a release. CJADO refers to a U.S. military concept to synchronize combat capabilities across land, air, sea, space and cyberspace into a single, networked force with allies like Korea. The topic featured on the agenda for the latest regular high-level strategy and coordination meeting on how the combined forces can better see, decide and act together in real time during modern warfare. At Wednesday's meeting, Jin stressed the need to ensure faster decision-making than the enemy through swift intelligence sharing from across every domain, according to the CFC's release. "Chairman Jin called for advancing command-and-control systems powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and cutting-edge science and technology, while ensuring interoperability through close Korea-U.S. coordination," the CFC said. Noting the importance of "speed" as a key factor that makes the difference on the Korean Peninsula, Brunson called for continuing to push forward with "attribute-based access control"(ABAC) so as to ensure data reaches the right place at the right time, according to the CFC. ABAC refers to a U.S. cybersecurity and data-sharing system that automatically shares sensitive battlefield data based on the user's clearance, role and mission, rather than manual approvals. The CJADO concept has gained traction here after Brunson repeatedly highlighted the need to advance its implementation. He recently made the point at a public event in September, calling for breaking away from the silos-oriented warfare structure and taking tangible steps to adapt to the changing modern warfare. To integrate force capabilities with international allies, how to create a combined network for information sharing and decision-making is regarded as key to CJADO implementation

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国和驻韩美军（USFK）最高军事将领周三讨论了促进各领域联合行动的努力，重点是顺畅共享情报。盟军联合司令部（CFC）表示，韩国联合参谋长会议议长金永成将军与兼任CFC司令的驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军共同主持了会议，讨论联合部队如何协同推进被称为“联合全域联合作战”（CJADO）的战略。CFC在一份声明中表示，CJADO是指美国军事概念，即将与韩国等盟国的陆、海、空、天和网络空间作战能力同步整合为一支互联一体的力量。在最新一次定期举行的高级战略与协调会议上，各方讨论了现代战争期间联合部队如何更好地实时协同感知、决策和行动，该议题被列入会议议程。据CFC的声明，在周三的会议上，金强调，需要通过快速共享各个领域的情报，确保决策速度超过敌人。CFC称：“金议长呼吁推进由人工智能（AI）和尖端科学技术驱动的指挥控制系统，同时通过韩美密切协调确保互操作性。”据CFC介绍，布伦森强调“速度”是决定朝鲜半岛局势成败的关键因素之一，并呼吁继续推进“基于属性的访问控制”（ABAC），确保数据能够在正确的时间送达正确的地点。ABAC是一套美国网络安全与数据共享系统，可根据用户的权限、角色和任务自动共享敏感战场数据，而无需人工审批。在布伦森反复强调推进CJADO落实之后，这一概念在韩国逐渐受到关注。他最近曾在9月举行的一场公开活动中指出，应摆脱以孤立体系为导向的战争结构，并采取切实措施适应不断变化的现代战争。为了与国际盟军整合作战能力，如何建立信息共享和决策综合网络被视为落实CJADO的关键。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho was acquitted Wednesday of charges of obstructing a National Assembly vote to lift former President Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law declaration in late 2024, when he was the floor leader of the then ruling People Power Party (PPP). The Seoul Central District Court delivered the verdict in the case against Choo, who stood trial on charges of playing a key role in Yoon's alleged insurrection. Choo was accused of changing the venue of an emergency party meeting three times on Dec. 3, 2024, after Yoon declared martial law, in an attempt to prevent lawmakers from taking part in a parliamentary vote on ending the emergency decree. Of the 108 PPP lawmakers, 90 were unable to attend the vote to lift the martial law at the time. Special counsel Cho Eun-suk's team had requested a 20-year prison term for Choo. Choo, however, maintained his innocence, saying he had no prior knowledge of the martial law imposition and had received no request from Yoon to block the National Assembly vote. The court said it was difficult to conclude that Yoon had asked the defendant to block the vote to lift martial law. Even if Yoon had made such a request, the evidence presented by the special counsel was insufficient to establish that the defendant had agreed to it, the court noted
